translations.literal: Treatise 111
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 111

sentences.zh: 兵七

translations.literal: Military 7
translations.idiomatic: Military 7

sentences.zh: 海軍

translations.literal: Navy
translations.idiomatic: Navy

sentences.zh: 中國初無海軍，自道光年籌海防，始有購艦外洋以輔水軍之議。

translations.literal: China at first had no navy; from the Daoguang era, when coastal defense was planned, there first arose discussion of purchasing ships abroad to assist the river fleet.
translations.idiomatic: China initially had no navy. Once coastal defense was taken up in the Daoguang reign, officials first began to discuss buying warships overseas to strengthen the river fleets.

sentences.zh: 同治初，曾國籓、左宗棠諸臣建議設船廠、鐵廠。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Tongzhi reign, ministers such as Zeng Guofan and Zuo Zongtang recommended establishing shipyards and ironworks.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tongzhi reign, Zeng Guofan, Zuo Zongtang, and other ministers urged the founding of shipyards and iron mills.

sentences.zh: 沈葆楨興船政於閩海，李鴻章築船塢於旅順，練北洋海軍，是為有海軍之始。

translations.literal: Shen Baozhen raised the ship administration at Minhai; Li Hongzhang built a dry dock at Lüshun and trained the Beiyang Navy—this was the beginning of having a navy.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Baozhen launched the Fujian ship administration on the Min coast; Li Hongzhang built a dry dock at Lüshun and drilled the Beiyang Navy. This marked the real beginning of a Chinese navy.

sentences.zh: 而甲申馬江，甲午東海，師船盡毀。

translations.literal: But at Mawei in jiashen (1884) and in the East China Sea in jiawu (1894), the fleet ships were utterly destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet at Mawei in 1884 and in the East China Sea in 1894, the fleet was wiped out.

sentences.zh: 嗣後兵艦歲有購置。

translations.literal: Thereafter warships were purchased year by year.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward warships were bought every year.

sentences.zh: 自光緒中葉迄宣統初，南北洋海軍僅有船五十餘艘，舊式居半。

translations.literal: From mid-Guangxu to early Xuantong, the Beiyang and Nanyang navies had only a little over fifty vessels, half of them of obsolete types.
translations.idiomatic: From the middle Guangxu years through the early Xuantong reign, the northern and southern fleets together mustered only a little more than fifty ships, and half were obsolete designs.

sentences.zh: 其能出海任戰者，止海籌、海圻等巡洋艦四艘，楚泰、楚謙、江元、江亨等砲艦十餘艘而已。

translations.literal: Those able to put to sea for battle were only four cruisers such as Haichou and Haiqi, and a dozen-odd gunboats such as Chutai, Chuqian, Jiangyuan, and Jiangheng.
translations.idiomatic: Of these, only four cruisers—the Haichou, Haiqi, and their like—and a dozen or so gunboats such as the Chutai, Chuqian, Jiangyuan, and Jiangheng were fit to fight at sea.

sentences.zh: 爰紀開創之漸，修繕之規，廠塢之建築，兵艦之購造，咸列於篇。

translations.literal: Herein are recorded the gradual founding, repair regulations, construction of yards and docks, and purchase and building of warships—all set forth in this chapter.
translations.idiomatic: What follows records step by step the founding of the service, rules for repair, the building of yards and docks, and the purchase and construction of warships.

sentences.zh: 十一年，曾國籓疏請購買外洋船砲。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Zeng Guofan memorialized requesting purchase of foreign ships and cannon.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year [Xianfeng, 1861], Zeng Guofan memorialized asking to buy foreign ships and guns.

sentences.zh: 奕訢等請以關稅買購外洋小兵輪十餘艘。

translations.literal: Yixin and others requested using customs revenue to purchase over ten small foreign steamers.
translations.idiomatic: Yixin and others proposed paying for more than ten small foreign steamers out of customs duties.

sentences.zh: 飭廣東、江蘇各督撫募內地人學習駕駛。

translations.literal: Orders were issued to the governors-general of Guangdong and Jiangsu to recruit natives to learn navigation.
translations.idiomatic: The governors-general of Guangdong and Jiangsu were ordered to recruit inland men to learn how to sail the ships.

sentences.zh: 以已租之美利堅輪船二艘，一名土只坡，一名可敷本，為護運之用，配以砲械，駛赴安慶，隸曾國籓調遣。

translations.literal: Two American steamers already leased—one named Tuzhipo, one named Kefuben—were used for escort duty, fitted with artillery, sailed to Anqing, and placed under Zeng Guofan's command.
translations.idiomatic: Two American steamers already on lease—the Tulip and the Cabbage—were armed for convoy duty, sent up to Anqing, and placed at Zeng Guofan's disposal.

sentences.zh: 五年，左宗棠疏請於福建省擇地設廠，購機器，募洋匠，自造火輪兵船。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Zuo Zongtang memorialized requesting to select a site in Fujian Province to establish a yard, purchase machinery, hire foreign craftsmen, and build steam gunboats themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year [Tongzhi, 1866], Zuo Zongtang asked permission to choose a site in Fujian, buy machinery, hire foreign engineers, and build steam gunboats on their own.

sentences.zh: 聘洋員日意格等，買築鐵廠船槽及中外公廨、工匠住屋、築基砌岸一切工程。

translations.literal: Foreign staff such as Prosper Giquel were hired to purchase and build the ironworks, ship slip, Chinese and foreign offices, craftsmen's quarters, and all works of laying foundations and building quays.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign advisers including Prosper Giquel were engaged to procure and erect the iron mill, slipways, offices for Chinese and foreign staff, workers' housing, and all foundation and quay work.

sentences.zh: 開設學堂，招選生徒，習英、法語言文字、算學、圖畫。

translations.literal: A school was opened and students selected to study English and French language and writing, mathematics, and drawing.
translations.idiomatic: A school was opened and pupils recruited to study English and French, mathematics, and drafting.

sentences.zh: 採辦鋼鐵木料。

translations.literal: Steel, iron, and timber were procured.
translations.idiomatic: Steel, iron, and timber were procured.

sentences.zh: 期五年內成大小輪船若干，均仿外洋兵船之式，需銀三百萬兩。

translations.literal: It was planned that within five years a number of large and small steamers would be completed, all modeled on foreign men-of-war, requiring three million taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Within five years a number of large and small steamers were to be finished, all modeled on foreign warships, at a cost of three million taels.

sentences.zh: 並陳船政事宜十則，請簡重臣督理。

translations.literal: He also set forth ten articles on ship administration affairs and requested appointment of a high minister to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: He also laid out ten points on how the ship administration should be run and asked that a senior minister be appointed to oversee it.

sentences.zh: 旋以沈葆楨為船政大臣。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter Shen Baozhen was made Minister of the Ship Administration.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Baozhen was soon appointed Minister of the Ship Administration.

sentences.zh: 六年，李鴻章遷虹口製造局於高昌廟，建船塢，名曰江南製造局。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Li Hongzhang moved the Hongkou Manufacturing Bureau to Gaochangmiao, built a dry dock, and named it the Jiangnan Manufacturing Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year [Tongzhi, 1867], Li Hongzhang moved the Hongkou arsenal to Gaochangmiao, built a dry dock, and renamed the complex the Jiangnan Manufacturing Bureau.

sentences.zh: 沈葆楨疏言：「福州馬尾山，為省垣奧區天險，設船塢於馬尾之中歧。

translations.literal: Shen Baozhen memorialized: "Mount Mawei at Fuzhou is a strategic natural barrier for the provincial capital; a dry dock was established at the middle fork of Mawei."
translations.idiomatic: Shen Baozhen reported: "Mount Mawei at Fuzhou guards the capital's approaches by land and water; the dry dock was placed at the middle reach of the Mawei anchorage."

sentences.zh: 塢周四百五十丈有奇。

translations.literal: The dock perimeter was a little over four hundred and fifty zhang.
translations.idiomatic: The yard measured a little more than four hundred and fifty zhang around its perimeter.

sentences.zh: 鐵船槽長三十丈，寬十五丈，可修造二千五百頓之船。

translations.literal: The iron ship slip was thirty zhang long and fifteen zhang wide, able to repair and build ships of twenty-five hundred tons.
translations.idiomatic: The iron slip was thirty zhang long and fifteen wide and could service vessels of twenty-five hundred tons.

sentences.zh: 塢內濱江者為鐵廠、輪廠、斫木匠架木棧房。

translations.literal: Along the river within the dock were the ironworks, engine works, and carpenters' sheds and timber stacks.
translations.idiomatic: Along the riverfront inside the yard stood the ironworks, engine shop, carpenters' sheds, and timber stacks.

sentences.zh: 塢東北為船政大臣駐所，紳員公所及外國匠房。

translations.literal: Northeast of the dock were the residence of the Minister of Ship Administration, the gentry and staff offices, and the foreign craftsmen's quarters.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast lay the minister's residence, offices for gentry and staff, and quarters for foreign craftsmen.

sentences.zh: 其左為法文、英文學堂及生徒住舍。

translations.literal: To its left were the French and English schools and student dormitories.
translations.idiomatic: To the left were the French and English schools and the students' dormitories.

sentences.zh: 江干為煤廠，山麓為中國匠房，山之左駐楚軍一營，山之右為洋員駐所。

translations.literal: On the riverbank was the coal yard; at the foot of the hill were the Chinese craftsmen's shops; on the left of the hill was stationed one battalion of Chu troops; on the right of the hill was the foreign staff residence.
translations.idiomatic: The coal yard stood on the riverbank; Chinese workshops lined the hillside; a battalion of Hunan troops camped on the left slope and foreign staff quarters on the right.

sentences.zh: 傍江岸為官街，以便貿易。

translations.literal: Along the riverbank was an official street to facilitate trade.
translations.idiomatic: An official street ran along the shore to support local trade.

sentences.zh: 」旋派洋員日意格回國採辦器具，選用工匠。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter the foreign adviser Giquel was sent home to procure equipment and select craftsmen.
translations.idiomatic: " Giquel was then sent back to Europe to buy tools and recruit skilled workers.

sentences.zh: 是年，瑞麟向英國訂購六兵船。

translations.literal: That year, Ruilin ordered six men-of-war from Britain.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ruilin ordered six gunboats from Britain.

sentences.zh: 七年，沈葆楨疏言：「於船塢之右，創建船臺四座，臺長二十餘丈，船成入水，順推而下。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Shen Baozhen memorialized: "To the right of the dry dock four launching ways were built, each over twenty zhang long; when a ship was finished it entered the water and was pushed down smoothly."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year [Tongzhi, 1868], Shen Baozhen reported that four launching ways, each more than twenty zhang long, had been built to the right of the dry dock so that completed hulls could be eased straight into the water.

sentences.zh: 其旁增五廠，曰鐵廠，曰水缸廠，曰打鐵廠，曰鑄鐵廠，曰合攏鐵器廠。

translations.literal: Beside them five workshops were added, called the ironworks, boiler works, forging shop, foundry, and iron-fitting assembly shop.
translations.idiomatic: Five shops were added beside them: the ironworks, boiler shop, forge, foundry, and iron-fitting assembly plant.

sentences.zh: 規模既具，次第興工。

translations.literal: Once the scale was complete, work proceeded in order.
translations.idiomatic: With the layout in place, construction moved ahead in stages.

sentences.zh: 」尋疏陳：「外洋機器到閩，復運煤運木於臺灣，運塼於廈門。

translations.literal: He soon memorialized further: When foreign machinery reached Fujian, coal and timber were again transported from Taiwan and bricks from Xiamen.
translations.idiomatic: He soon added that once foreign machinery reached Fujian, coal and timber were shipped in from Taiwan and bricks from Xiamen.

sentences.zh: 廠內增設轉鋸廠、木模廠、銅廠、風洞、繪事廠、廣儲廠、儲材廠、東西考工所，先後告竣。

translations.literal: Within the yard were added a sawmill, pattern shop, copper works, wind tunnel, drafting office, general storehouse, materials storehouse, and eastern and western examination workshops—all completed in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Inside the yard they added a sawmill, pattern shop, copper works, wind tunnel, drafting office, storehouses, and eastern and western inspection shops, finishing them one after another.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，諭英桂、馬新貽、李福泰、卞寶第等籌給經費，俾蕆要工。

translations.literal: When the memorial was received, Yinggui, Ma Xinyi, Li Futai, Bian Baodi, and others were instructed to provide funds so that the essential works could be completed.
translations.idiomatic: The throne then ordered Yinggui, Ma Xinyi, Li Futai, Bian Baodi, and others to supply funds so the critical work could be finished.

sentences.zh: 是年，曾國籓疏言：「上海設廠，自造第一號輪船告成。

translations.literal: That year, Zeng Guofan memorialized: "At the Shanghai yard, the first self-built steamer was completed."
translations.idiomatic: That year Zeng Guofan reported that the Shanghai yard had launched its first home-built steamer.

sentences.zh: 汽爐船身，皆考究圖說，自出機杼。

translations.literal: The boiler and hull were both worked out from careful study of plans and were original designs.
translations.idiomatic: Its boiler and hull were designed from careful study of the plans and were original work.

sentences.zh: 長十八丈，寬二丈餘，命名恬吉。

translations.literal: It was eighteen zhang long and a little over two zhang wide, and was named Tianji.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteen zhang long and a little over two wide, she was named the Tianji.

sentences.zh: 請續造二十餘丈之大艦。

translations.literal: He requested continued building of large ships of over twenty zhang.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that larger ships of more than twenty zhang be built next.

sentences.zh: 」旋諭兩江總督馬新貽等，從曾國籓、李鴻章所請，製器設廠，增建譯館諸端，悉心講求。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter the Governor-General of Liangjiang Ma Xinyi and others were instructed to follow the requests of Zeng Guofan and Li Hongzhang regarding manufacturing, establishing yards, adding translation bureaus, and other matters, and to pursue them diligently.
translations.idiomatic: The court then told Liangjiang governor-general Ma Xinyi and his colleagues to carry out Zeng Guofan's and Li Hongzhang's proposals on arsenals, shipyards, translation schools, and the like with full attention.

sentences.zh: 是年，福州船廠自造安瀾等小輪船十艘告成，濟安、永保、海鏡等輪船亦告成。

translations.literal: That year, the Fuzhou shipyard completed ten small steamers such as the Anlan, and the steamers Jian, Yongbao, Haijing, and others were also completed.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Fuzhou yard finished ten small steamers including the Anlan, and the Jian, Yongbao, Haijing, and other vessels as well.

sentences.zh: 八年，沈葆楨疏言：「廠中自製第一號大輪船下水，長二十三丈八尺，寬二丈七尺八寸，每小時行八十里，以副將率弁兵水手管駕，安置巨砲，駛出大洋，暫名曰萬年青。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Shen Baozhen memorialized: "The yard's first large self-built steamer was launched, twenty-three zhang eight chi long and two zhang seven chi eight cun wide, making eighty li per hour; a vice commander led officers, soldiers, and sailors in its management; great guns were mounted; it sailed out to the open ocean; it was provisionally named Wannianqing."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year [Tongzhi, 1869], Shen Baozhen reported that the yard's first large steamer had been launched—twenty-three zhang eight chi long, two zhang seven chi eight cun wide, and eighty li an hour under steam. A vice commander took charge of officers, sailors, and marines; heavy guns were mounted; and the ship put to sea under the provisional name Wannianqing.

sentences.zh: 第二號暫名曰湄雲，俟駛赴天津，再請錫名，以光海宇。

translations.literal: The second was provisionally named Meiyun; when it sailed to Tianjin, a bestowed name would again be requested to glorify the maritime realm.
translations.idiomatic: The second was provisionally called the Meiyun; once she reached Tianjin, they would ask the throne for an imperial name to honor the fleet.

sentences.zh: 」是年，購法國澄波兵船。

translations.literal: That year, the French gunboat Chengbo was purchased.
translations.idiomatic: That year they bought the French gunboat Chengbo.

sentences.zh: 江南製測海、操江兵船成。

translations.literal: Jiangnan completed the men-of-war Cehai and Caojiang.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangnan yard finished the Cehai and Caojiang.

sentences.zh: 又購建威、海東雲二船。

translations.literal: The Jianwei and Haidongyun were also purchased.
translations.idiomatic: They also bought the Jianwei and Haidongyun.

sentences.zh: 九年，沈葆楨疏言：「第三號福星船，第四號伏波船告成，本屬戰艦，利於巡洋，以學堂上等學生移處船中，令洋員教其駕駛，由近而遠，以收實效。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Shen Baozhen memorialized: "The third ship Fuxing and fourth ship Fubo were completed; they were originally warships suited for cruising; advanced students from the school were moved aboard and foreign instructors were ordered to teach them navigation, from near to far, to gain practical results."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year [Tongzhi, 1870], Shen Baozhen reported that the Fuxing and Fubo were finished. Built as cruisers, they now housed the school's senior students, with foreign instructors teaching them to sail from coastal waters out to the open sea.

sentences.zh: 」是年，江南威靖兵船成。

translations.literal: That year, Jiangnan completed the men-of-war Weijing.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Jiangnan yard also finished the Weijing.

sentences.zh: 十年，令學生十八人駕建威練船，巡歷南北各海口。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, eighteen students were ordered to sail the training ship Jianwei on a cruise of the northern and southern ports.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year [Tongzhi, 1871], eighteen students were sent out on the training ship Jianwei to visit ports north and south.

sentences.zh: 是年，曾國籓疏請仿英國小鐵船式，令滬廠製造，為守海口之用。

translations.literal: That year, Zeng Guofan memorialized requesting imitation of the British small ironclad type and ordering the Shanghai yard to build them for guarding the river mouths.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zeng Guofan asked that the Shanghai yard copy Britain's small ironclads for harbor defense.

sentences.zh: 十一年，船政製安瀾、鎮海、揚武、飛雲、靖遠五兵船成。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the Ship Administration completed five men-of-war: Anlan, Zhenhai, Yangwu, Feiyun, and Jingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year [Tongzhi, 1872], the ship administration launched five gunboats: the Anlan, Zhenhai, Yangwu, Feiyun, and Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 文煜、宋晉等以造船費重，疏請暫罷，不許。

translations.literal: Wenyu, Song Jin, and others, on the grounds that shipbuilding costs were heavy, memorialized requesting a temporary halt; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Wenyu, Song Jin, and others asked to suspend construction because of the expense, but the court refused.

sentences.zh: 是年，李鴻章疏言：「滬廠造成第五號船，長三十丈，鍋爐均在水線之下，置大砲二十六尊，系仿外洋三枝桅兵船式，英、法人稱為中國最巨之船。

translations.literal: That year, Li Hongzhang memorialized: "The Shanghai yard completed its fifth ship, thirty zhang long, with boilers all below the waterline and twenty-six large guns mounted; it followed the foreign three-masted men-of-war type; English and French called it China's largest ship."
translations.idiomatic: That year Li Hongzhang reported that the Shanghai yard had launched its fifth ship—thirty zhang long, boilers below the waterline, and twenty-six heavy guns—a copy of a foreign three-masted warship that British and French observers called the largest vessel in China.

sentences.zh: 請飭沿江海各省，不得自向外洋購船，如有所需，向閩、滬二廠商撥訂製，以節度支。

translations.literal: He requested that the provinces along the rivers and coast be ordered not to purchase ships abroad on their own; if they had need, they should order from the Fujian and Shanghai yards to save expenditures.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that coastal provinces be forbidden to buy ships abroad on their own and told to order from the Fujian and Shanghai yards instead, so funds would not be wasted.

sentences.zh: 十二年，江南製海安兵船成。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Jiangnan completed the men-of-war Haian.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year [Tongzhi, 1873], the Jiangnan yard finished the Haian.

sentences.zh: 沈葆楨疏言：「閩廠七號揚武、八號飛雲兵船下水。

translations.literal: Shen Baozhen memorialized: "At the Fujian yard, the seventh ship Yangwu and eighth ship Feiyun were launched."
translations.idiomatic: Shen Baozhen reported that the Fujian yard had launched the Yangwu (No. 7) and Feiyun (No. 8).

sentences.zh: 揚武用英國前膛砲，飛雲用布國後膛砲。

translations.literal: The Yangwu used British muzzle-loading guns; the Feiyun used Prussian breech-loading guns.
translations.idiomatic: The Yangwu carried British muzzle-loaders; the Feiyun, Prussian breech-loaders.

sentences.zh: 以後十三、十四、十五號兵船，請兼仿外洋商舶之式，運載貨物，以裕經費。

translations.literal: For the thirteenth, fourteenth, and fifteenth men-of-war hereafter, he requested that they also imitate foreign merchant vessels in form and carry cargo to supplement funds.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that ships thirteen through fifteen also follow merchant-ship lines so they could carry cargo and help pay for the program.

sentences.zh: 九號靖遠、十號振威、十一號濟安、十二號永保、十三號海鏡兵船已告成，以都司、游擊等管駕出洋。

translations.literal: The ninth Jingyuan, tenth Zhenwei, eleventh Jian, twelfth Yongbao, and thirteenth Haijing were already completed, with brigade commanders, regimental commanders, and others commanding them on voyages overseas.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyuan (No. 9), Zhenwei (No. 10), Jian (No. 11), Yongbao (No. 12), and Haijing (No. 13) were already in service, commanded at sea by brigade and regimental officers.

sentences.zh: 其建威練船，巡歷浙江、上海、天津、牛庄及香港、新加坡、檳榔嶼等處。

translations.literal: The training ship Jianwei cruised through Zhejiang, Shanghai, Tianjin, Niuzhuang, and Hong Kong, Singapore, Penang, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: The training ship Jianwei had cruised to Zhejiang, Shanghai, Tianjin, Niuzhuang, Hong Kong, Singapore, Penang, and other ports.

sentences.zh: 在船學徒，練習風濤，成績甚優。

translations.literal: Apprentices aboard practiced in wind and waves with very fine results.
translations.idiomatic: The apprentices aboard had trained in heavy weather with excellent results.

sentences.zh: 來年遣散洋匠，以中國學徒自造。

translations.literal: The next year foreign craftsmen would be dismissed and Chinese apprentices would build on their own.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the foreign engineers would be sent home and Chinese apprentices would build the ships alone.

sentences.zh: 然能守已成之法，不能拓未竟之緒。

translations.literal: Yet they could keep established methods but could not extend unfinished threads.
translations.idiomatic: They could follow methods already mastered, but could not advance techniques still unfinished.

sentences.zh: 請選擇學生，分赴英、法二國，深究造船駕駛之方，練兵制勝之理。

translations.literal: He requested selection of students to be sent separately to Britain and France to study deeply the methods of shipbuilding and navigation and the principles of training troops and gaining victory.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that selected students be sent to Britain and France to master shipbuilding and navigation and the principles of drilling men and winning battles.

sentences.zh: 十三年，船政製濟安、琛航、大雅三運船成。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, the Ship Administration completed three transport ships: Jian, Chenhang, and Daya.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year [Tongzhi, 1874], the ship administration finished three transports: the Jian, Chenhang, and Daya.

sentences.zh: 福建善後局購美國二砲船，曰福勝、建勝。

translations.literal: The Fujian Pacification Bureau purchased two American gunboats named Fusheng and Jiansheng.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian Pacification Bureau bought two American gunboats, the Fusheng and Jiansheng.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章疏言：「中國東南北三洋，請各設大兵船六艘，根缽小兵船十艘，合成四十八艘。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang memorialized: "For China's eastern, southern, and northern seas, he requested that each be provided with six large men-of-war and ten small gunboats of the genbo type, totaling forty-eight vessels."
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang proposed that China's eastern, southern, and northern fleets each receive six large warships and ten smaller gunboats, forty-eight ships in all.

sentences.zh: 三洋各需大鐵船二艘。

translations.literal: Each of the three seas required two large ironclads.
translations.idiomatic: Each fleet also needed two large ironclads.

sentences.zh: 北洋駐煙臺、旅順等處，東洋駐長江口外，南洋駐廈門、虎門等處。

translations.literal: The Beiyang fleet was to be stationed at Yantai, Lüshun, and other places; the Dongyang at the mouth of the Yangzi; the Nanyang at Xiamen, Humen, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: The northern squadron would base at Yantai and Lüshun, the eastern off the Yangzi mouth, and the southern at Xiamen, Humen, and similar ports.

sentences.zh: 鐵甲船每艘需銀百萬兩外，分年向外洋購置。

translations.literal: Each ironclad required over a million taels of silver and was to be purchased abroad over successive years.
translations.idiomatic: Each ironclad would cost more than a million taels and was to be bought abroad year by year.

sentences.zh: 餘船由閩、滬二廠仿造，以足四十八艘之數。

translations.literal: The remaining ships were to be copied at the Fujian and Shanghai yards to make up the number of forty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: The rest were to be built at the Fujian and Shanghai yards until the full forty-eight were ready.

sentences.zh: 請飭沿江沿海各省，裁併新舊紅單、拖罟、艇船、舢板等船，以節省之款，專練海軍。

translations.literal: He requested that the provinces along the rivers and coast be ordered to merge and cut old and new hongdan, tuogu, launch, and sampan vessels and use the savings exclusively to train the navy.
translations.idiomatic: He asked coastal provinces to scrap redundant patrol craft—old and new hongdan, tuogu, launches, and sampans—and devote the savings to building the navy.

sentences.zh: 」是年，沈葆楨疏言：「續辦船工，尚有三端：一、挖土大機船，一、船土鐵脅，一、新式輪機。

translations.literal: That year, Shen Baozhen memorialized: In continuing ship work, three items remained: first, a large dredging steamer; second, iron ribs for ships; third, new-style engines.
translations.idiomatic: That year Shen Baozhen added that three projects still lay ahead: a large dredger, iron framing for hulls, and modern engines.

sentences.zh: 鐵脅須購自法國，以閩船皆法匠所造也。

translations.literal: Iron ribs had to be purchased from France, because Fujian ships were all built by French craftsmen.
translations.idiomatic: Iron ribs would have to come from France, since Fujian's yards relied on French shipwrights.

sentences.zh: 臥機、立機須購自英國，以其製精無弊也。

translations.literal: Horizontal and vertical engines had to be purchased from Britain, because their manufacture was refined and without defect.
translations.idiomatic: Horizontal and vertical engines should be bought in Britain, where workmanship was finest.

sentences.zh: 二年，沈葆楨會同李鴻章奏派學生，分赴英、法各國，入大學堂、製造局練習。

translations.literal: In the second year, Shen Baozhen together with Li Hongzhang memorialized dispatching students separately to Britain and France to practice in universities and manufacturing bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year [Guangxu, 1876], Shen Baozhen and Li Hongzhang jointly sent students to Britain and France for training in universities and arsenals.

sentences.zh: 此為第一屆出洋學生。

translations.literal: This was the first cohort of students sent abroad.
translations.idiomatic: This was the first group of students sent overseas.

sentences.zh: 是年，船政製登瀛洲、蓺新兩兵船成。

translations.literal: That year, the Ship Administration completed two men-of-war: Dengyingzhou and Yixin.
translations.idiomatic: That year the ship administration launched the Dengyingzhou and Yixin.

sentences.zh: 製造局製金甌小鐵甲船成。

translations.literal: The Manufacturing Bureau completed the small ironclad Jin'ou.
translations.idiomatic: The manufacturing bureau finished the small ironclad Jin'ou.

sentences.zh: 三年、四年，泰安、威遠、超武兵船亦成。

translations.literal: In the third and fourth years, the men-of-war Taian, Weiyuan, and Chaowu were also completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third and fourth years [Guangxu, 1877–1878], the Taian, Weiyuan, and Chaowu were launched as well.

sentences.zh: 沈葆楨疏請各省協款，每年解南北洋各二百萬，專儲為籌辦海軍之用，期十年成南洋、北洋、粵洋海軍三大枝，猶恐緩不濟急，請以四百萬先解北洋，俟成軍後，再解南洋。

translations.literal: Shen Baozhen memorialized requesting coordinated contributions from the provinces of two million each year to Beiyang and Nanyang, stored exclusively for preparing the navy, expecting within ten years to complete three major branches—Nanyang, Beiyang, and Yueyang navies; still fearing that slow would not meet urgent need, he requested that four million first be sent to Beiyang and, after the army was formed, then to Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Baozhen asked the provinces to contribute two million taels a year to each of the northern and southern fleets, with the goal of three full squadrons within ten years. Fearing delay, he proposed sending four million taels to the northern fleet first and funding the south only after it was ready.

sentences.zh: 五年，李鴻章疏言，外洋訂購之四砲船來華，以福建船政局員管駕，名飛霆、策電、龍驤、虎威，砲射甚遠，輪機亦精，請再購四艘。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Li Hongzhang memorialized that four gunboats ordered abroad had arrived in China, commanded by Fujian Ship Administration officers, named Feiting, Cedain, Longxiang, and Huwei; their guns shot very far and their engines were also fine; he requested purchase of four more.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year [Guangxu, 1879], Li Hongzhang reported that four gunboats ordered abroad had arrived—the Feiting, Cedain, Longxiang, and Huwei—manned by Fujian shipyard officers. Their guns ranged far and their engines were excellent, and he asked to buy four more.

sentences.zh: 沈葆楨疏言，續購蚊砲船四艘到華，以留學英國畢業生管駕，名鎮東、鎮西、鎮南、鎮北，分防吳淞、江陰二口，為夾護砲臺之用。

translations.literal: Shen Baozhen memorialized that four additional mosquito gunboats had arrived in China, commanded by graduates who had studied in Britain, named Zhendong, Zhenxi, Zhennan, and Zhenbei, divided to defend the mouths of Wusong and Jiangyin, for the purpose of flanking and protecting the batteries.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Baozhen reported that four more mosquito gunboats had arrived, commanded by graduates of study in Britain—the Zhendong, Zhenxi, Zhennan, and Zhenbei—stationed at Wusong and Jiangyin to shield the forts.

sentences.zh: 何璟疏言：「閩廠製造各兵船，惟揚武、威遠、濟安較為得力，其餘止供巡緝內洋之用。

translations.literal: He Jing memorialized: "Of the various men-of-war built at the Fujian yard, only Yangwu, Weiyuan, and Jian were relatively effective; the rest served only for patrolling the inner seas."
translations.idiomatic: He Jing observed that of the Fujian-built gunboats only the Yangwu, Weiyuan, and Jian were truly useful; the rest could patrol only coastal waters.

sentences.zh: 」旋諭沿江海各督撫整頓海軍。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter the governors-general along the rivers and coast were instructed to put the navy in order.
translations.idiomatic: The court then ordered coastal governors to reorganize the navy.

sentences.zh: 沈葆楨旋卒，海軍屬李鴻章。

translations.literal: Shen Baozhen soon died, and the navy passed to Li Hongzhang.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Baozhen died soon after, and Li Hongzhang took charge of the navy.

sentences.zh: 設海軍營務處於天津。

translations.literal: A Navy Camp Affairs Office was established at Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: A naval headquarters was set up at Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 六年，江督劉坤一疏言：「蚊砲船購自外洋，費鉅而砲位過重。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Jiangsu Governor-General Liu Kunyi memorialized: "Mosquito gunboats purchased abroad cost greatly and their gun mounts were too heavy."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year [Guangxu, 1880], Jiangsu governor-general Liu Kunyi complained that foreign mosquito gunboats were costly and top-heavy.

sentences.zh: 請由粵自造木殼船，丈尺與包鐵者同，砲位改用三萬餘斤之後膛砲，先造二艘，以備守口之用。

translations.literal: He requested that Guangdong build wooden-hulled ships on its own, of the same dimensions as ironclad ones, changing the gun mounts to use breech-loading guns of over thirty thousand jin, first building two for guarding the river mouths.
translations.idiomatic: He asked Guangdong to build wooden-hulled ships the size of ironclads, mounting thirty-thousand-jin breech-loaders instead, starting with two for harbor defense.

sentences.zh: 」李鴻章疏請購外洋每半時行十五海里之快船及碰船、蚊子船。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang memorialized requesting purchase abroad of fast ships making fifteen nautical miles per half hour, as well as ram ships and mosquito boats.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang, meanwhile, asked to buy foreign dispatch vessels capable of fifteen knots, plus rams and mosquito boats.

sentences.zh: 又疏言：「購辦鐵甲船之舉，倡議已歷七年。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "The initiative to purchase ironclads had been proposed for seven years already."
translations.idiomatic: He added that plans to buy ironclads had been debated for seven years.

sentences.zh: 福建已定購蚊子船四艘，碰船二艘。

translations.literal: Fujian had already ordered four mosquito boats and two ram ships.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian had already ordered four mosquito boats and two rams.

sentences.zh: 請移二碰船之價一百三十萬兩，先購鐵甲船一艘，專歸臺灣防剿。

translations.literal: He requested shifting the price of the two ram ships, 1.3 million taels, to purchase first one ironclad, devoted exclusively to defense and suppression in Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed redirecting the 1.3 million taels set aside for the two rams to buy one ironclad for Taiwan's defense instead.

sentences.zh: 以原有之福勝、建勝二蚊子船及船廠自造兵輪之堅利者，合為一軍，則臺防可固。

translations.literal: Taking the existing Fusheng and Jiansheng two mosquito boats and the stout gunboats built by the shipyards, combining them into one force, then Taiwan's defense could be secured.
translations.idiomatic: If the existing Fusheng and Jiansheng mosquito boats were combined with the sturdiest yard-built gunboats into a single squadron, Taiwan's defenses could be held.

sentences.zh: 南洋擬購之快碰船二艘，亦請抵購鐵甲船一艘。

translations.literal: As for the two quick-firing ram ships the Nanyang Fleet planned to purchase, he also requested applying their cost toward purchasing one ironclad.
translations.idiomatic: He further asked that the two quick-firing rams the Nanyang Fleet intended to buy be applied instead toward purchasing one ironclad.

sentences.zh: 當與南洋大臣會商，合原有之各兵輪，編練海軍，互為應援。

translations.literal: He should consult with the Nanyang governor-general, combining the various existing gunboats, organizing and training a navy, and mutually supporting each other.
translations.idiomatic: He should confer with the Nanyang governor-general to consolidate existing gunboats, drill a navy, and coordinate mutual support.

sentences.zh: 」旋以滬廠因鑄造槍砲經費過重，停造輪船。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter, because the Shanghai yard's expenses for casting firearms and cannon were too heavy, shipbuilding was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly thereafter, the Shanghai yard halted ship construction because casting guns and cannon had grown prohibitively expensive.

sentences.zh: 閩廠亦以財絀停造木質兵船，專造快船與鐵甲船。

translations.literal: The Fujian yard also, because of financial shortage, halted building wooden gunboats, specializing in building fast ships and ironclads.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian yard likewise stopped building wooden gunboats for lack of funds and concentrated on fast cruisers and ironclads.

sentences.zh: 是年，吉林將軍銘安請於三姓一帶造舢板戰船。

translations.literal: That year, Jilin General Ming'an requested building sampan war vessels in the Sanshing area.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Jilin Governor Ming'an proposed building sampan fighting craft around Sansxing.

sentences.zh: 諭李鴻章籌度。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Li Hongzhang to plan and assess.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered Li Hongzhang to study the matter.

sentences.zh: 鴻章覆陳俄國於庫葉島設廠造兵輪，輒由混同江駛入松花江等處，非舢板所能敵。

translations.literal: Hongzhang memorialized in reply that Russia, having set up a yard on Sakhalin to build gunboats, would often enter the Songhua River and other places via the Amur—sampan boats could not match them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang replied that Russia was building gunboats at a yard on Sakhalin and sailing them up the Amur into the Songhua and elsewhere—craft that sampans could not withstand.

sentences.zh: 請於三姓水深之處，設廠造蚊子船，可巡駛及黑龍江，以佐陸軍。

translations.literal: He requested establishing a yard at a deep-water spot at Sansxing to build mosquito boats, able to patrol as far as the Amur, to assist the army.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to erect a yard at a deep-water site near Sansxing to build mosquito boats capable of patrolling the Amur in support of the land forces.

sentences.zh: 鴻章尋向英訂造新式鐵甲船，並飭閩廠仿造。

translations.literal: Hongzhang soon ordered from Britain a new-style ironclad, and also directed the Fujian yard to copy it.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang soon contracted with Britain for a new ironclad and ordered the Fujian yard to copy the design.

sentences.zh: 彭玉麟亦請飭閩廠分造十七、八丈之小兵輪十艘，以長江任戰之員為管帶，巡緝洋面。

translations.literal: Peng Yulin also requested directing the Fujian yard to build in batches ten small gunboats of seventeen or eighteen zhang, with Yangtze combat officers as commanders, to patrol the open sea.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Yulin also asked that the Fujian yard build ten small gunboats of seventeen or eighteen zhang, commanded by Yangtze combat officers, to patrol offshore waters.

sentences.zh: 諭兩江、福建、廣東各省籌辦。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the provinces of Liangjiang, Fujian, and Guangdong to arrange the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The throne directed Liangjiang, Fujian, and Guangdong to carry out the plan.

sentences.zh: 是年，在英廠訂造之超勇、揚威快碰船來華，令提督丁汝昌管駕，與鎮中、鎮邊蚊砲船二艘，同泊旅順。

translations.literal: That year, the Chaoyong and Yangwei quick-firing rams ordered from British yards arrived in China; Admiral Ding Ruchang was ordered to command them, together with the two mosquito gunboats Zhenzhong and Zhenbian, all moored at Lüshun.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Chaoyong and Yangwei quick-firing rams built in Britain arrived; Admiral Ding Ruchang was put in command of them and the mosquito gunboats Zhenzhong and Zhenbian, all of which were stationed at Lüshun.

sentences.zh: 又於閩廠訂造快船二艘，專為朝鮮口岸之用。

translations.literal: Two fast ships were also ordered from the Fujian yard, exclusively for use at Korean ports.
translations.idiomatic: Two fast cruisers were also ordered from the Fujian yard for service at Korean ports.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章設水師學堂於天津。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang established a naval academy at Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang founded a naval academy at Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 旋以在德國船廠定購之定遠、鎮遠二鐵艦，濟遠穹甲艦將成，令管輪學生赴德國練習。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter, because the two ironclads Dingyuan and Zhenyuan ordered from German shipyards and the protected cruiser Jiyuan were nearing completion, engine-room cadets were ordered to Germany for training.
translations.idiomatic: When the ironclads Dingyuan and Zhenyuan and the protected cruiser Jiyuan, all ordered from German yards, were nearing completion, engine cadets were sent to Germany for training.

sentences.zh: 令洋教習率鎮東等四兵船赴渤海一帶梭巡。

translations.literal: Foreign instructors were ordered to lead the four gunboats including Zhendong to patrol back and forth in the Bohai area.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign instructors were dispatched with four gunboats including the Zhendong to patrol the Bohai Gulf.

sentences.zh: 是年，船政製澄慶兵船成。

translations.literal: That year, the Ship Administration completed the gunboat Chengqing.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Fujian shipyard launched the gunboat Chengqing.

sentences.zh: 七年，李鴻章在大沽口建船塢。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Li Hongzhang built a dry dock at Dagu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year [Guangxu, 1881], Li Hongzhang built a dry dock at Dagu.

sentences.zh: 九月，超勇、揚威二艦製成來華。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the two ships Chaoyong and Yangwei were completed and came to China.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Chaoyong and Yangwei were completed and arrived in China.

sentences.zh: 鴻章乘赴旅順，察看形勢，籌備建築船塢、砲壘。

translations.literal: Hongzhang took ship to Lüshun, inspected the terrain, and planned construction of dry docks and batteries.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang sailed to Lüshun to survey the ground and plan dry docks and batteries.

sentences.zh: 大沽設水雷營、水雷學堂。

translations.literal: At Dagu a torpedo corps and torpedo school were established.
translations.idiomatic: Dagu gained a torpedo corps and torpedo school.

sentences.zh: 旅順設水雷魚雷營、挖泥船。

translations.literal: At Lüshun a torpedo and mine corps and dredgers were established.
translations.idiomatic: Lüshun received a torpedo and mine unit along with dredgers.

sentences.zh: 威海設魚雷局、機器廠，並設屯煤所。

translations.literal: At Weihai a torpedo bureau, machine shops, and coal depots were established.
translations.idiomatic: Weihai was furnished with a torpedo bureau, machine shops, and coal storage depots.

sentences.zh: 以丁汝昌統領北洋海軍。

translations.literal: Ding Ruchang was appointed to command the Beiyang Navy.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Ruchang was placed in overall command of the Beiyang Navy.

sentences.zh: 定兵艦國旗質地章色之制。

translations.literal: Regulations were fixed for the fabric, color, and insignia of naval ensigns.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations governing naval ensigns—their fabric, color, and badge—were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 會同福建船政派學生赴歐洲肄業。

translations.literal: In concert with the Fujian Ship Administration, students were dispatched to Europe for study.
translations.idiomatic: Students were sent to Europe for training in cooperation with the Fujian shipyard.

sentences.zh: 八年，北洋、粵督各購德國雷艇數艘。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the Beiyang Fleet and the Guangdong governor each purchased several German torpedo boats.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year [Guangxu, 1882], the Beiyang Fleet and the Guangdong governor each bought several German torpedo boats.

sentences.zh: 以英人琅威理司海軍訓練，與各國兵艦相遇，始有迎送交接之禮。

translations.literal: With the Englishman William Lang supervising naval training, when meeting foreign warships there were for the first time ceremonies of greeting, seeing off, and handover.
translations.idiomatic: Under the British adviser William Lang, naval drill introduced for the first time the ceremonial courtesies observed when meeting foreign warships.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章疏言英、法、美、德國近年所造船，曰穹面鋼甲快船，入水十五尺八寸，馬力二千八百匹，壓水力二千三百頓，每時行十五海里，合中國五十里，機艙等鋼面厚三寸半，砲臺周圍鋼面厚至十寸，每艘需銀六十二萬兩，與鐵艦相輔，最為海軍利器。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang memorialized that in recent years the ships built by Britain, France, America, and Germany were called domed-armor steel fast cruisers, drawing fifteen chi eight cun of water, with 2,800 horsepower and 2,300 tons displacement, traveling fifteen nautical miles per hour—equivalent to fifty Chinese li—with engine-room and other steel plates three and a half cun thick and battery armor up to ten cun thick; each ship required 620,000 taels of silver and, together with ironclads, formed the navy's finest weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang reported that Britain, France, the United States, and Germany were now building domed-armor steel cruisers drawing fifteen chi eight cun, rated at 2,800 horsepower and 2,300 tons displacement, and capable of fifteen knots—about fifty Chinese li per hour. Their engine rooms were armored with three-and-a-half-cun steel plate and their batteries with up to ten cun; each cost 620,000 taels. Paired with ironclads, they were the navy's most effective weapons.

sentences.zh: 閩廠自造快船不及其精，已由出使大臣訂購一艘，與鎮遠鐵艦同駛來華。

translations.literal: The fast ships built by the Fujian yard did not match their refinement; the minister abroad had already ordered one, to sail to China together with the ironclad Zhenyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian yard's own fast cruisers were inferior; the minister abroad had therefore ordered one to sail home alongside the ironclad Zhenyuan.

sentences.zh: 九年，船政製開濟快碰船成。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, the Ship Administration completed the quick-firing ram Kaiji.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year [Guangxu, 1883] the Fujian shipyard launched the quick-firing ram Kaiji.

sentences.zh: 南洋向德國購南琛、南瑞二巡洋艦。

translations.literal: The Nanyang Fleet purchased from Germany the cruisers Nanchen and Nanrui.
translations.idiomatic: The Nanyang Fleet bought the cruisers Nanchen and Nanrui from Germany.

sentences.zh: 十年，船政製鏡清快碰船、橫海兵船成。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the Ship Administration completed the quick-firing ram Jingqing and the gunboat Henghai.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year [Guangxu, 1884] the Fujian shipyard launched the quick-firing ram Jingqing and the gunboat Henghai.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章疏言，自光緒元年至六年，經營北洋海防，有龍驤等蚊砲船八艘，水雷小艇一艘。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang memorialized that from the first year of Guangxu through the sixth, in managing Beiyang coastal defense there were eight mosquito gunboats including Longxiang, and one small torpedo boat.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang reported that from the first through sixth years of Guangxu [1875–1880], in building up Beiyang coastal defense he had acquired eight mosquito gunboats including the Longxiang, plus one small torpedo boat.

sentences.zh: 其龍、虎、霆、電四船，於六年撥赴南洋調遣。

translations.literal: Among them, the four ships Longxiang, Huwei, Feiting, and Cedain were transferred to the Nanyang Fleet for dispatch in the sixth year.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the Longxiang, Huwei, Feiting, and Cedain were assigned to the Nanyang Fleet.

sentences.zh: 七年以後，先後購到超勇、揚威快碰船二艘，鎮中、鎮邊蚊砲船二艘。

translations.literal: After the seventh year, the Chaoyong and Yangwei quick-firing rams and the Zhenzhong and Zhenbian mosquito gunboats were purchased in succession.
translations.idiomatic: After the seventh year [1881] he successively acquired the quick-firing rams Chaoyong and Yangwei and the mosquito gunboats Zhenzhong and Zhenbian.

sentences.zh: 由閩廠調至北洋，修改練船之威遠、康濟兵輪二艘。

translations.literal: From the Fujian yard the drill ships Weiyuan and Kangji were transferred to the Beiyang Fleet and refitted.
translations.idiomatic: The drill ships Weiyuan and Kangji were transferred from the Fujian yard to the Beiyang Fleet and refitted.

sentences.zh: 調赴朝鮮、旅順等處，海鏡一艘。

translations.literal: The Haijing was dispatched to Korea, Lüshun, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: The Haijing was stationed at Korea, Lüshun, and other stations.

sentences.zh: 在滬製造之快馬小輪船一艘。

translations.literal: One small fast steamer built at Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: One small fast steamer was built at Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 在津製造之利順小輪船一艘。

translations.literal: One small steamer named Lishun built at Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: One small steamer, the Lishun, was built at Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 守雷、下雷所用之暗輪包鋼小輪船二艘。

translations.literal: Two small screw steamers with steel sheathing used for laying and retrieving mines.
translations.idiomatic: Two small screw steamers sheathed in steel for laying and recovering mines.

sentences.zh: 察看船隻之大小，頓載之輕重，機器、砲位、桅帆器械之繁簡，配定人數、餉章，與水師統領、教習洋員分別損益，務使利器可得實用。

translations.literal: Examining each vessel's size, tonnage, and the complexity of its machinery, gun mounts, masts, sails, and equipment, he fixed complements, pay scales, and rations in consultation with the naval commander and foreign instructors, adjusting as needed so that fine weapons would prove truly useful.
translations.idiomatic: He assessed each ship's size, tonnage, and the complexity of its machinery, guns, masts, and gear, then set complements, pay, and rations in consultation with the fleet commander and foreign instructors, adjusting details so that these advanced vessels could be used effectively.

sentences.zh: 是年五月，以長江水師提督李成謀總統南洋兵輪。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of that year, Yangtze naval commander Li Chengmo was appointed to command the Nanyang gunboats.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of that year, Yangtze naval commander Li Chengmo was made commander of the Nanyang gunboat force.

sentences.zh: 總督曾國荃疏言：「江南購買兵輪蚊、快等船及自造者，為數無多。

translations.literal: Governor-General Zeng Guoquan memorialized: "The mosquito boats, fast ships, and other gunboats purchased and built in Jiangnan are not many in number.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Zeng Guoquan reported that Jiangnan's purchased and locally built mosquito boats, fast cruisers, and other gunboats were few in number.

sentences.zh: 所有登瀛洲、靖遠、澄慶、開濟、龍驤、虎威、飛霆、策電、威靖、測海、馭遠、金甌大小兵輪，及新購之南琛、南瑞，上海機器局所造之鋼板保民兵輪，各船大小不齊，兵額不一，以之海戰則不足，以之扼守江海門戶，與砲臺相輔，藉固江防。

translations.literal: Among them are the large and small gunboats Dengyingzhou, Jingyuan, Chengqing, Kaiji, Longxiang, Huwei, Feiting, Cedain, Weijing, Cehai, Yuyuan, Jin'ou, the newly purchased Nanchen and Nanrui, and the steel-plated Baomin gunboat built by the Shanghai machine works—each ship of different size and with a different complement; insufficient for fleet action, yet adequate, together with batteries, to hold the river and sea gates and strengthen river defense.
translations.idiomatic: The force included the Dengyingzhou, Jingyuan, Chengqing, Kaiji, Longxiang, Huwei, Feiting, Cedain, Weijing, Cehai, Yuyuan, Jin'ou, the newly bought Nanchen and Nanrui, and the Shanghai-built steel gunboat Baomin—vessels of varied size and crew strength. They were too few for open battle, but together with coastal batteries they could guard the river mouths and bolster river defense.

sentences.zh: 」八月，法國海軍犯福建。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the French navy attacked Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the French navy attacked Fujian.

sentences.zh: 駐防福州海口之揚武、振威、飛雲、伏波、濟安、福星、蓺新兵船七艘，蚊砲船二艘，琛航、永保商輪二艘，與法國兵船戰於馬江，悉數沈毀，存者惟伏波、蓺新二船。

translations.literal: Seven gunboats stationed at the Fuzhou river mouth—the Yangwu, Zhenwei, Feiyun, Fubo, Ji'an, Fuxing, and Yixin—together with two mosquito gunboats and the merchant steamers Chenhang and Yongbao, fought French warships at the Mawei River; all were sunk and destroyed, and only the Fubo and Yixin survived.
translations.idiomatic: Seven gunboats defending the Fuzhou estuary—the Yangwu, Zhenwei, Feiyun, Fubo, Ji'an, Fuxing, and Yixin—along with two mosquito gunboats and the merchant steamers Chenhang and Yongbao, fought the French at the Mawei River. All were sunk except the Fubo and Yixin.

sentences.zh: 時李鴻章令德國武員率快船五艘，與曾國荃所部開濟、南琛、南瑞、澄慶、馭遠五船援閩，未至而閩師已覆，澄慶、馭遠二船亦沉於石浦。

translations.literal: At the time Li Hongzhang ordered a German military officer to lead five fast ships and the five vessels Kaiji, Nanchen, Nanrui, Chengqing, and Yuyuan under Zeng Guoquan's command to aid Fujian; before they arrived the Fujian fleet had already been destroyed, and the Chengqing and Yuyuan were also sunk at Shipu.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang then sent a German officer with five fast cruisers and Zeng Guoquan's Kaiji, Nanchen, Nanrui, Chengqing, and Yuyuan to reinforce Fujian, but they arrived too late—the Fujian squadron was already destroyed, and the Chengqing and Yuyuan were sunk at Shipu.

sentences.zh: 是年，總理衙門請設海軍專部。

translations.literal: That year, the Zongli Yamen requested establishing a dedicated naval ministry.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Zongli Yamen asked to create a separate naval department.

sentences.zh: 出使大臣許景澄在德國訂購之定遠、鎮遠鐵甲艦二艘，濟遠鋼甲艦一艘均告成。

translations.literal: The two ironclads Dingyuan and Zhenyuan and the armored cruiser Jiyuan ordered in Germany by Minister Abroad Xu Jingcheng were all completed.
translations.idiomatic: The ironclads Dingyuan and Zhenyuan and the armored cruiser Jiyuan that Minister Abroad Xu Jingcheng had ordered in Germany were all completed.

sentences.zh: 粵督向德國訂購雷艇八艘。

translations.literal: The Guangdong governor ordered eight torpedo boats from Germany.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong governor ordered eight torpedo boats from Germany.

sentences.zh: 十一年，曾國荃疏言：「於福建、廣東、浙江三省增設鐵艦、快艦、雷艇。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Zeng Guoquan memorialized: "Ironclads, fast cruisers, and torpedo boats should be added in Fujian, Guangdong, and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year [Guangxu, 1885], Zeng Guoquan proposed adding ironclads, fast cruisers, and torpedo boats in Fujian, Guangdong, and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 嗣後各兵船專事操練巡洋，不得載勇拖船。

translations.literal: Thereafter each gunboat should devote itself exclusively to drill and cruising, and must not carry troops or tow ships.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter every warship was to train and cruise exclusively, without carrying troops or towing other vessels.

sentences.zh: 」與北洋大臣會奏，派第三屆學生出洋。

translations.literal: Together with the Beiyang governor-general he jointly memorialized to dispatch the third cohort of students abroad.
translations.idiomatic: He and the Beiyang governor-general jointly memorialized to send the third cohort of students overseas.

sentences.zh: 同時，左宗棠疏請開採鐵礦，擇吳、楚扼要處，立船政砲廠，專造鐵甲兵船、後膛巨砲。

translations.literal: At the same time, Zuo Zongtang memorialized requesting opening iron mines, choosing strategic points in Wu and Chu, establishing shipyards and cannon foundries, and specializing in building ironclad warships and breech-loading great cannon.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time, Zuo Zongtang asked to open iron mines, establish shipyards and foundries at strategic sites in the Yangtze region, and concentrate on building ironclads and heavy breech-loading guns.

sentences.zh: 製造局製保兵鋼板船成。

translations.literal: The Manufacturing Bureau completed the steel-plated gunboat Baomin.
translations.idiomatic: The Manufacturing Bureau launched the steel-plated gunboat Baomin.

sentences.zh: 九月，海軍衙門成立。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the Naval Yamen was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Naval Yamen was established.

sentences.zh: 以醇親王總理海軍，慶郡王、李鴻章為會辦，曾紀澤、善慶為幫辦。

translations.literal: Prince Chun was appointed to direct the navy, with Prince Qing and Li Hongzhang as co-directors and Zeng Jize and Shan Qing as assistant directors.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Chun was placed in charge of the navy, with Prince Qing and Li Hongzhang as co-directors and Zeng Jize and Shan Qing as deputies.

sentences.zh: 十二年，粵省造淺水兵輪，曰廣元、廣亨、廣利、廣貞，防護海口。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Guangdong province built shallow-draft gunboats named Guangyuan, Guangheng, Guangli, and Guangzhen to protect the river mouth.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year [Guangxu, 1886], Guangdong built the shallow-draft gunboats Guangyuan, Guangheng, Guangli, and Guangzhen for harbor defense.

sentences.zh: 向德國購福龍魚雷艇一艘。

translations.literal: One torpedo boat named Fulong was purchased from Germany.
translations.idiomatic: One torpedo boat, the Fulong, was purchased from Germany.

sentences.zh: 三月，南洋兵船赴北洋會操。

translations.literal: In the third month, Nanyang gunboats went to the Beiyang Fleet for joint maneuvers.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Nanyang gunboats sailed north for joint exercises with the Beiyang Fleet.

sentences.zh: 命醇親王、李鴻章校閱海陸軍及沿海臺壘。

translations.literal: Prince Chun and Li Hongzhang were ordered to inspect the army, navy, and coastal batteries.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Chun and Li Hongzhang were ordered to review the land and naval forces and coastal fortifications.

sentences.zh: 丁汝昌率兵船巡歷朝鮮。

translations.literal: Ding Ruchang led gunboats on a patrol circuit through Korea.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Ruchang led a squadron on patrol through Korean waters.

sentences.zh: 船政大臣裴廕森於福州增設練船，造鐵甲船，疏言：「江蘇之上海，廣東之黃埔，雖有船塢，而港道狹淺。

translations.literal: Naval Superintendent Pei Yinsen, having added drill ships at Fuzhou and begun building ironclads, memorialized: "At Shanghai in Jiangsu and Whampoa in Guangdong, although there are dry docks, the channels are narrow and shallow.
translations.idiomatic: Naval Superintendent Pei Yinsen, who had added drill ships at Fuzhou and begun building ironclads, reported that although Shanghai and Whampoa each had dry docks, their channels were too narrow and shallow.

sentences.zh: 福建羅星塔之下、員山寨之上，兩山間有天成巨港，請建大船塢，備定遠等鐵艦修理之處。

translations.literal: Below Luoxing Pagoda and above Yuanshan Fort in Fujian, a great natural harbor lies between two mountains; he requested building a large dry dock there as a repair facility for ironclads such as the Dingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Below Luoxing Pagoda and above Yuanshan Fort in Fujian, a great natural harbor lay between two hills; he asked to build a large dry dock there to service ironclads such as the Dingyuan.

sentences.zh: 十三年，閩廠寰泰快碰船、廣甲兵船造成，並造雙機鋼甲輪船及穹式快船、淺水兵輪。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, the Fujian yard completed the quick-firing ram Huantai and the gunboat Guangjia, and also built twin-engine armored steamers, domed fast cruisers, and shallow-draft gunboats.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year [Guangxu, 1887] the Fujian yard launched the quick-firing ram Huantai and the gunboat Guangjia, and also built twin-engine armored steamers, domed cruisers, and shallow-draft gunboats.

sentences.zh: 是年，北洋向英國購左一出海魚雷大快艇一艘，向德國購左二、左三、右一、右二、右三魚雷艇五艘，挖泥船一艘。

translations.literal: That year the Beiyang Fleet purchased from Britain one large seagoing torpedo launch named Left One, from Germany five torpedo boats named Left Two, Left Three, Right One, Right Two, and Right Three, and one dredger.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Beiyang Fleet bought from Britain one large seagoing torpedo launch, Left One, from Germany five torpedo boats—Left Two, Left Three, Right One, Right Two, and Right Three—and one dredger.

sentences.zh: 北京設水師學堂於昆明湖，廣東設水師學堂於黃埔。

translations.literal: A naval academy was established at Kunming Lake in Beijing and another at Whampoa in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Naval academies were founded at Kunming Lake in Beijing and at Whampoa in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 十四年，海軍衙門奏定官制，設提督、總兵、副將、參將、游擊、都司、守備、千總、把總、經制外委等官。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, the Naval Yamen fixed an official hierarchy, establishing the posts of admiral, vice admiral, rear admiral, commodore, captain, commander, lieutenant commander, lieutenant, sub-lieutenant, and brevet midshipman.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year [Guangxu, 1888] the Naval Yamen promulgated a rank structure, creating posts from admiral down through vice admiral, rear admiral, commodore, captain, commander, lieutenant commander, lieutenant, sub-lieutenant, and brevet midshipman.

sentences.zh: 是年，在英、德廠所造致遠、靖遠、經遠、來遠四快船來華。

translations.literal: That year the four fast cruisers Zhiyuan, Jingyuan, Jingyuan, and Laiyuan built in British and German yards arrived in China.
translations.idiomatic: That year the four fast cruisers Zhiyuan, Jingyuan, Jingyuan, and Laiyuan ordered from Britain and Germany arrived in China.

sentences.zh: 英百濟公司所造出海魚雷快艇亦告成。

translations.literal: The seagoing torpedo launches built by the British Baiji company were also completed.
translations.idiomatic: Seagoing torpedo launches built by the British Baiji company were also completed.

sentences.zh: 六月，臺灣番民叛，命致遠、靖遠二艦往剿平之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Taiwan aborigines rebelled; the Zhiyuan and Jingyuan were ordered to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, when Taiwan aborigines rebelled, the Zhiyuan and Jingyuan were sent to suppress the uprising.

sentences.zh: 十五年，船政製平遠鋼甲船、廣庾兵船成。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, the Ship Administration completed the armored ship Pingyuan and the gunboat Guangyu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year [Guangxu, 1889] the Fujian shipyard launched the armored ship Pingyuan and the gunboat Guangyu.

sentences.zh: 十六年，裴廕森疏言，閩廠修整龍威鋼甲兵輪，更名平遠，廣乙魚雷快船亦告成，併入北洋艦隊操演。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Pei Yinsen memorialized that the Fujian yard had refitted the armored gunboat Longwei, renaming it Pingyuan, and that the torpedo fast cruiser Guangyi was also completed and incorporated into Beiyang fleet maneuvers.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year [Guangxu, 1890], Pei Yinsen reported that the Fujian yard had refitted the armored gunboat Longwei as the Pingyuan, that the torpedo cruiser Guangyi was also finished, and that both joined Beiyang fleet exercises.

sentences.zh: 又言石船塢告成，請簡專員董理。

translations.literal: He also stated that the stone dry dock was completed and requested appointing a dedicated superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported that the stone dry dock was finished and asked that a dedicated superintendent be appointed.

sentences.zh: 八月，北洋設水師學堂於劉公島，南洋設水師學堂於南京。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the Beiyang Fleet established a naval academy at Liugong Island and the Nanyang Fleet established one at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Beiyang Fleet opened a naval academy on Liugong Island and the Nanyang Fleet opened one at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 十月，李鴻章疏言旅順口船塢工竣，堪為修理鐵艦之用，並築劉公島、青島等處沿海砲臺。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Li Hongzhang memorialized that the Lüshun dry dock was completed and suitable for repairing ironclads, and that coastal batteries were also built at Liugong Island, Qingdao, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Li Hongzhang reported that the Lüshun dry dock was finished and fit to repair ironclads, and that coastal batteries had also been built at Liugong Island, Qingdao, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 北洋所聘海軍總查英人琅威理，以爭提督升旗，辭職回國。

translations.literal: William Lang, the British chief naval inspector engaged by the Beiyang Fleet, resigned and returned home over a dispute about raising the admiral's flag.
translations.idiomatic: William Lang, the British chief inspector of the Beiyang Navy, resigned and returned home after a dispute over hoisting the admiral's flag.

sentences.zh: 英政府遂拒我海軍學生在英留學。

translations.literal: The British government thereupon refused to allow Chinese naval students to study in Britain.
translations.idiomatic: The British government then barred Chinese naval cadets from studying in Britain.

sentences.zh: 十七年，船政製廣丙魚雷快船成。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, the Ship Administration completed the torpedo fast cruiser Guangbing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year [Guangxu, 1891] the Fujian shipyard launched the torpedo cruiser Guangbing.

sentences.zh: 二月，命直隸總督李鴻章、山東巡撫張曜出海閱海軍操。

translations.literal: In the second month, Zhili Governor-General Li Hongzhang and Shandong Governor Zhang Yao were ordered to put to sea and review naval maneuvers.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Zhili Governor-General Li Hongzhang and Shandong Governor Zhang Yao were ordered to sea to inspect naval exercises.

sentences.zh: 北洋之定遠等十二艦，廣東之廣甲等三艦，南洋之寰泰等六艦，畢會於旅順口，操演船陣槍砲魚雷，並勘砲臺、船塢。

translations.literal: Twelve Beiyang ships including the Dingyuan, three Guangdong ships including the Guangjia, and six Nanyang ships including the Huantai all assembled at Lüshun, conducting drills in fleet formations, guns, and torpedoes, and also inspecting batteries and dry docks.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve Beiyang ships led by the Dingyuan, three Guangdong ships including the Guangjia, and six Nanyang ships including the Huantai assembled at Lüshun for formation, gunnery, and torpedo drills, and to inspect batteries and dry docks.

sentences.zh: 四月，戶部請停購外洋槍砲船隻機器二年，以所節價銀解部充餉。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, the Board of Revenue requested halting purchases of foreign firearms, cannon, ships, and machinery for two years, remitting the savings to the ministry to cover pay.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the Board of Revenue asked to suspend foreign purchases of arms, cannon, ships, and machinery for two years and send the savings to the capital to cover salaries.

sentences.zh: 六月，提督丁汝昌率兵艦六艘赴日本東京。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Admiral Ding Ruchang led six warships to Tokyo, Japan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Admiral Ding Ruchang sailed six warships to Tokyo.

sentences.zh: 七月，威海增設魚雷三營。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, three additional torpedo battalions were established at Weihai.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month three torpedo battalions were added at Weihai.

sentences.zh: 十九年，船政製福靖魚雷快船成。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, the Ship Administration completed the torpedo fast cruiser Fujing.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year [Guangxu, 1893] the Fujian shipyard launched the torpedo cruiser Fujing.

sentences.zh: 粵督改水師講堂為水師學堂。

translations.literal: The Guangdong governor converted the naval lecture hall into a naval academy.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong governor reorganized the naval lecture hall as a naval academy.

sentences.zh: 二十年，船政製通濟練船成。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, the Ship Administration completed the drill ship Tongji.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year [Guangxu, 1894] the Fujian shipyard launched the drill ship Tongji.

sentences.zh: 訂購英國砲艦一艘，命名福安。

translations.literal: One British gunboat was ordered and named Fu'an.
translations.idiomatic: One gunboat was ordered from Britain and named the Fu'an.

sentences.zh: 二月，鎮遠、定遠二艦置新式克鹿卜快砲十二尊。

translations.literal: In the second month, twelve new-model Krupp quick-firing guns were installed on the Zhenyuan and Dingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Zhenyuan and Dingyuan were fitted with twelve new Krupp quick-firing guns.

sentences.zh: 四月，朝鮮內亂，北洋遣兵艦往剿。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, when civil strife broke out in Korea, the Beiyang Fleet dispatched warships to suppress it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, when Korea fell into civil disorder, the Beiyang Fleet sent warships to intervene.

sentences.zh: 五月，與日本兵船戰於牙山口外，濟遠船傷，廣乙船沈，操江船失，載兵之高升商船亦沈。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, they fought Japanese warships off the Yalu estuary; the Jiyuan was damaged, the Guangyi was sunk, the Caojiang was lost, and the troop transport merchant ship Gaosheng was also sunk.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month they fought Japanese warships off the Yalu estuary: the Jiyuan was damaged, the Guangyi sunk, the Caojiang captured, and the troopship Gaosheng sunk as well.

sentences.zh: 九月，丁汝昌率北洋兵艦與日本戰於大東溝，失致遠、經遠、超勇、揚威四艦。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Ding Ruchang led Beiyang warships against Japan in battle at the Yalu River mouth, losing the Zhiyuan, Jingyuan, Chaoyong, and Yangwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Ding Ruchang fought the Japanese in the Battle of the Yalu, losing the Zhiyuan, Jingyuan, Chaoyong, and Yangwei.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，日本以師船攻威海，定遠、鎮遠各艦亦失，丁汝昌敗死。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, Japan attacked Weihai with its fleet; the Dingyuan, Zhenyuan, and other ships were also lost, and Ding Ruchang was defeated and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year [Guangxu, 1895], Japan's fleet attacked Weihai; the Dingyuan, Zhenyuan, and other ships were lost, and Ding Ruchang was defeated and took his own life.

sentences.zh: 冬，南洋訂購之辰、宿、列、張四雷艇來華。

translations.literal: In winter, the four torpedo boats Chen, Su, Lie, and Zhang ordered by the Nanyang Fleet arrived in China.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the four torpedo boats Chen, Su, Lie, and Zhang ordered by the Nanyang Fleet arrived.

sentences.zh: 飛霆、飛鷹二驅逐艦在英、德廠造成。

translations.literal: The two destroyers Feiting and Feiying were completed in British and German yards.
translations.idiomatic: The destroyers Feiting and Feiying were completed in Britain and Germany.

sentences.zh: 以康濟、飛霆、飛鷹、建靖各艦駐防北洋。

translations.literal: The Kangji, Feiting, Feiying, and Jianjing were stationed for defense in the Beiyang area.
translations.idiomatic: The Kangji, Feiting, Feiying, and Jianjing were assigned to Beiyang defense.

sentences.zh: 以南洋之開濟、鏡清、寰泰、南琛，福建之福靖兵艦往來調防。

translations.literal: The Nanyang ships Kaiji, Jingqing, Huantai, and Nanchen and the Fujian gunboat Fujing were transferred back and forth for defense.
translations.idiomatic: The Nanyang ships Kaiji, Jingqing, Huantai, and Nanchen and the Fujian gunboat Fujing were rotated among stations as needed.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，福州羅星塔石塢成。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, the stone dry dock at Luoxing Pagoda in Fuzhou was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year [Guangxu, 1896], the stone dry dock at Luoxing Pagoda near Fuzhou was completed.

sentences.zh: 閩浙總督邊寶泉請設法擴充船政。

translations.literal: Governor-General of Fujian and Zhejiang Bian Baoquan requested measures to expand the ship administration.
translations.idiomatic: Bian Baoquan, governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang, asked for ways to expand the naval shipyard administration.

sentences.zh: 總理衙門疏陳：「船政始於大學士左宗棠、兩江總督沈葆楨。

translations.literal: The Zongli Yamen memorialized: "The ship administration began under Grand Secretary Zuo Zongtang and Governor-General of the Two Jiangs Shen Baozhen.
translations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen reported that the ship administration had been founded by Grand Secretary Zuo Zongtang and Two Jiangs Governor-General Shen Baozhen.

sentences.zh: 嗣後十餘年，泰西製造日精，閩廠雖有出洋畢業學生，而財力短絀，既不能增機拓廠，復不能製料儲材。

translations.literal: In the more than ten years since, Western manufacturing grew daily more refined; although the Fujian yard had students who had graduated from study abroad, funds were short, so they could neither add machinery and expand the yard nor manufacture and stock materials.
translations.idiomatic: In the decade that followed, Western shipbuilding grew ever more advanced. The Fujian yard had graduates of overseas study, but funds were too short to add machinery, expand the yards, or manufacture and stock materials.

sentences.zh: 自光緒八、九年後，以購買之機器，就廠合攏，成寰泰、鏡清、平遠、開濟各快艦。

translations.literal: From the eighth and ninth years of Guangxu onward, purchased machinery was assembled at the yard to complete the fast cruisers Huantai, Jingqing, Pingyuan, and Kaiji.
translations.idiomatic: From Guangxu 8–9 [1882–83] onward, purchased machinery was assembled at the yard to build the fast cruisers Huantai, Jingqing, Pingyuan, and Kaiji.

sentences.zh: 而新出之法，以無機無廠，不能急起謀新。

translations.literal: Yet the newly emerging methods, for lack of machinery and yards, could not be urgently taken up to pursue innovation.
translations.idiomatic: New methods could not be adopted quickly for lack of machinery and expanded facilities.

sentences.zh: 同治年間所製之琛航、靖遠木質各艦，馬力微者，又不適於用。

translations.literal: The wooden vessels Chenhang and Jingyuan built during the Tongzhi reign, being weak in horsepower, were also unsuitable for use.
translations.idiomatic: The wooden ships Chenhang and Jingyuan built in the Tongzhi era were underpowered and likewise unsuitable for service.

sentences.zh: 凡一船之成，材居其七，工居其三。

translations.literal: For the completion of any ship, materials account for seven parts and labor for three.
translations.idiomatic: Building a ship costs roughly seventy percent in materials and thirty percent in labor.

sentences.zh: 各材之中，屬煤、鐵、土、木等為生料，有產自中國者，有產自外洋者；

translations.literal: Among the various materials, coal, iron, earth, timber, and the like count as raw materials; some are produced in China, some come from abroad;
translations.idiomatic: Raw materials included coal, iron, earth, and timber, some sourced domestically and some from abroad;

sentences.zh: 屬鋼甲、鐵甲、帆、纜等為熟料，有能自製者，有必待增機廠而製者。

translations.literal: steel plate, iron plate, sails, cables, and the like count as finished materials; some could be made locally, some could be made only after machinery and yards were added.
translations.idiomatic: Finished goods such as steel plate, iron plate, sails, and cables—some could be made locally, others only after adding machinery and expanding the yards.

sentences.zh: 請簡用重臣督辦，開採礦產，增購機械，獎勵學生，籌度經費，以期日起有功。

translations.literal: He requested appointing a senior minister to supervise the work, opening mines, purchasing more machinery, encouraging students, and planning funds, in hope of daily growing achievement.
translations.idiomatic: It asked that a senior official be appointed to supervise mining, purchase machinery, support students, and plan funding so that progress might be made day by day.

sentences.zh: 」四月，在德國訂造海容、海籌、海琛三巡洋艦。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, three cruisers—Haichong, Haichou, and Haichen—were ordered in Germany.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month three cruisers—the Haichong, Haichou, and Haichen—were ordered from Germany.

sentences.zh: 五月，在英國訂造海天、海圻二巡洋艦。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, two cruisers—Haitian and Haiqi—were ordered in Britain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month two cruisers—the Haitian and Haiqi—were ordered from Britain.

sentences.zh: 是年，以福州將軍裕祿兼船政大臣，諭加整頓。

translations.literal: That year, Fuzhou General Yu Lu was additionally appointed naval superintendent, with orders to strengthen administration.
translations.idiomatic: That year Fuzhou General Yu Lu was also made naval superintendent and ordered to put the administration in order.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，德國據山東膠州灣，法租廣州灣，英租威海衛，俄租旅順、大連灣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Germany seized Jiaozhou Bay in Shandong; France leased Guangzhou Bay; Britain leased Weihaiwei; Russia leased Lüshun and Dalian Bay.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year [Guangxu, 1897] Germany seized Jiaozhou Bay in Shandong, France leased Guangzhou Bay, Britain leased Weihaiwei, and Russia leased Lüshun and Dalian Bay.

sentences.zh: 是年，船政製福安運船成。

translations.literal: That year, the ship administration completed the transport ship Fu'an.
translations.idiomatic: That year the ship administration launched the transport Fu'an.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，船政製吉雲拖船成。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, the ship administration completed the tug Jiyun.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year [Guangxu, 1898] the ship administration completed the tug Jiyun.

sentences.zh: 諭各督撫於船政原有經費外，別籌專款，以振海軍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered each governor-general and governor, beyond the ship administration's existing funds, to raise separate appropriations to revive the navy.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered governors-general and governors to raise dedicated funds beyond existing shipyard appropriations to rebuild the navy.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，在德訂購之海龍、海華、海青、海犀來華。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, the Hailong, Haihua, Haiqing, and Haixi ordered in Germany arrived in China.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year [Guangxu, 1899] the Hailong, Haihua, Haiqing, and Haixi, ordered in Germany, arrived in China.

sentences.zh: 諭沿海疆臣，增設海軍學堂，講求駕駛戰術。

translations.literal: An edict ordered coastal frontier officials to establish naval academies and study navigation and battle tactics.
translations.idiomatic: Coastal officials were ordered to establish naval academies and train officers in navigation and tactics.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，拳匪亂作，北洋各艦悉赴南洋。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Boxer unrest broke out, and all Beiyang ships went south to the Nanyang Fleet.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year [Guangxu, 1900] the Boxer uprising erupted and every Beiyang vessel was sent south to Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，和議成，海容軍艦回防。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, peace was concluded, and the warship Haichong returned to station.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year [Guangxu, 1901], after peace was made, the Haichong returned to her station.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，船政製建威、建安魚雷快船、建翼魚雷艇成。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, the ship administration completed the torpedo fast boats Jianwei and Jian'an and the torpedo boat Jianyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year [Guangxu, 1902] the ship administration completed the torpedo fast boats Jianwei and Jian'an and the torpedo boat Jianyi.

sentences.zh: 又製淺水巡洋兵船二艘，一曰安海，一曰定海。

translations.literal: Two shallow-water cruiser gunboats were also completed, one named Anhai and one named Dinghai.
translations.idiomatic: It also launched two shallow-water cruiser gunboats, the Anhai and the Dinghai.

sentences.zh: 是年，船政會辦魏瀚，以監督杜業爾不職，遣回法國。

translations.literal: That year, ship administration co-director Wei Han, finding supervisor Du Ye'er negligent in duty, sent him back to France.
translations.idiomatic: That year co-director Wei Han dismissed the French supervisor Du Ye'er for neglect of duty and sent him home.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，張之洞疏言：「南洋各兵艦年久，咸不適用，徒費國帑。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, Zhang Zhidong memorialized: "The Nanyang gunboats are old; none are fit for service and they waste state funds.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year [Guangxu, 1903] Zhang Zhidong reported that Nanyang's warships were obsolete, unfit for duty, and a drain on the treasury.

sentences.zh: 各艦惟寰泰、鏡清二兵輪，威靖、登瀛二運船，尚可備巡緝之用。

translations.literal: Of all the ships, only the gunboats Huantai and Jingqing and the transports Weijing and Dengying are still fit for patrol and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Only the gunboats Huantai and Jingqing and the transports Weijing and Dengying remained useful for patrol duty.

sentences.zh: 其南瑞、南琛、保民三兵輪，龍驤、虎威、飛霆、策電四蚊船，請一律裁停。

translations.literal: The gunboats Nanrui, Nanchen, and Baomin and the four mosquito boats Longxiang, Huwei, Feiting, and Cedain should all be decommissioned.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to decommission the gunboats Nanrui, Nanchen, and Baomin and the mosquito boats Longxiang, Huwei, Feiting, and Cedain.

sentences.zh: 鈞和一船，令商人自養，為護商之用。

translations.literal: The Junhe alone should be maintained by merchants for protecting commerce.
translations.idiomatic: The Junhe alone was to be kept by merchants for convoy duty.

sentences.zh: 以所節之款，積之十年，可購長江淺水新式快船六、七艘。

translations.literal: With the funds saved, accumulated over ten years, six or seven new shallow-water fast ships for the Yangtze could be purchased.
translations.idiomatic: Savings accumulated over ten years could buy six or seven new shallow-water fast ships for the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 」允之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 是年，煙臺設海軍學校。

translations.literal: That year, a naval school was established at Yantai.
translations.idiomatic: That year a naval school was opened at Yantai.

sentences.zh: 江督向日本訂造江元淺水快船。

translations.literal: The Jiangsu governor ordered the shallow-water fast ship Jiangyuan from Japan.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangsu governor ordered the shallow-water fast cruiser Jiangyuan from Japan.

sentences.zh: 三十年，端方疏請選擇水師學生，由駐滬英國水師總兵，分派在英艦學習，較出洋遊歷，費少而收效同。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, Duanfang memorialized requesting that naval cadets be selected and assigned by the British naval commodore stationed at Shanghai to study aboard British ships—costing less than sending them abroad on tour yet yielding equal benefit.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year [Guangxu, 1904] Duanfang proposed training naval cadets aboard British ships under the British commodore at Shanghai—a cheaper alternative to overseas tours with comparable results.

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 南洋大臣周馥等，疏請以提督葉祖珪督辦南洋水師學堂、上海船塢。

translations.literal: Nanyang Superintendent Zhou Fu and others memorialized requesting that Admiral Ye Zugui supervise the Nanyang naval academy and the Shanghai dry dock.
translations.idiomatic: Nanyang Superintendent Zhou Fu and others asked that Admiral Ye Zugui oversee the Nanyang naval academy and the Shanghai dry dock.

sentences.zh: 湖廣總督張之洞在日本廠購雷艇四艘，曰湖鵬、湖鶚、湖鷹、湖隼；

translations.literal: Huguang Governor-General Zhang Zhidong purchased four torpedo boats from Japanese yards, named Hupeng, Hu'e, Huying, and Hun;
translations.idiomatic: Huguang Governor-General Zhang Zhidong bought four torpedo boats from Japanese yards—the Hupeng, Hu'e, Huying, and Hun;

sentences.zh: 淺水砲艦六艘，曰楚泰、楚同、楚豫、楚有、楚觀、楚謙。

translations.literal: and six shallow-water gunboats named Chutai, Chutong, Chuyu, Chuyou, Chuguan, and Chuqian.
