translations.idiomatic: and six shallow-water gunboats—the Chutai, Chutong, Chuyu, Chuyou, Chuguan, and Chuqian.

sentences.zh: 兩廣總督岑春煊開辦魚雷局於黃埔。

translations.literal: Liangguang Governor-General Cen Chunxuan established a torpedo bureau at Whampoa.
translations.idiomatic: Liangguang Governor-General Cen Chunxuan opened a torpedo bureau at Whampoa.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，以薩鎮冰總理南北洋海軍。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, Sa Zhenbing was placed in overall charge of the Beiyang and Nanyang navies.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year [Guangxu, 1905] Sa Zhenbing was made director of the Beiyang and Nanyang navies.

sentences.zh: 江督在日本廠購淺水快艦三艘，曰江亨、江利、江貞。

translations.literal: The Jiangsu governor purchased three shallow-water fast cruisers from Japanese yards, named Jiangheng, Jiangli, and Jiangzhen.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangsu governor bought three shallow-water fast cruisers from Japan—the Jiangheng, Jiangli, and Jiangzhen.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，政務處王大臣疏言：「振興海軍，首重軍港。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, a grand councillor memorialized: "To revive the navy, naval harbors come first.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year [Guangxu, 1906] a grand councillor argued that reviving the navy required naval bases above all.

sentences.zh: 沿海惟象山港形勢合宜。

translations.literal: Along the coast, only Xiangshan Harbor is suitably configured.
translations.idiomatic: Of coastal sites, only Xiangshan Harbor had suitable terrain.

sentences.zh: 請飭南北洋大臣勘度經營，以重戎備；

translations.literal: He requested ordering the Beiyang and Nanyang superintendents to survey and develop it to strengthen defenses;
translations.idiomatic: He asked the Beiyang and Nanyang superintendents to survey and develop it to strengthen coastal defense;

sentences.zh: 並飭各省選派學生四十人，赴日本留學海軍。

translations.literal: and order each province to select forty students to study naval affairs in Japan.
translations.idiomatic: and ordered each province to send forty students to Japan for naval training.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，設海軍處附於陸軍部內，設正副二使，機要、船政、運籌、儲備、醫務、法務六司。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, a Naval Office was attached within the Army Ministry, with two commissioners and six bureaus—secretariat, ship administration, operations, stores, medical affairs, and legal affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year [Guangxu, 1907] a Naval Office was placed under the Army Ministry, with two commissioners and six bureaus covering secretariat, ship administration, operations, stores, medical affairs, and legal affairs.

sentences.zh: 北洋大臣令海籌、海容二艦巡歷西貢、新加坡等處。

translations.literal: The Beiyang superintendent ordered the Haichou and Haichong to cruise Saigon, Singapore, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: The Beiyang superintendent sent the Haichou and Haichong to cruise Saigon, Singapore, and other ports.

sentences.zh: 商部令海圻、海琛二艦巡歷菲律賓島、爪哇島、蘇門答拉等處。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Commerce ordered the Haiqi and Haichen to cruise the Philippines, Java, Sumatra, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Commerce ordered the Haiqi and Haichen to cruise the Philippines, Java, Sumatra, and other islands.

sentences.zh: 粵督令廣亨、廣貞、安香、安東四艦巡歷九洲洋等處。

translations.literal: The Guangdong governor ordered the Guangheng, Guangzhen, Anxiang, and Andong to cruise the Jiuzhou seas and other waters.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong governor sent the Guangheng, Guangzhen, Anxiang, and Andong to patrol the Jiuzhou seas and neighboring waters.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，江南船塢製甘泉、安豐二船成。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, the Jiangnan dry dock completed the ships Ganquan and Anfeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year [Guangxu, 1908] the Jiangnan dry dock launched the Ganquan and Anfeng.

sentences.zh: 派學生赴日本習航海各技術。

translations.literal: Students were dispatched to Japan to study various navigation skills.
translations.idiomatic: Students were sent to Japan to train in navigation and related skills.

sentences.zh: 二年，江南船塢製聯鯨兵船成。

translations.literal: In the second year, the Jiangnan dry dock completed the gunboat Lianjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year [Xuantong, 1910] the Jiangnan dry dock completed the gunboat Lianjing.

sentences.zh: 日本訂購之二砲艦亦成。

translations.literal: Two gunboats ordered from Japan were also completed.
translations.idiomatic: Two gunboats ordered from Japan were also delivered.

sentences.zh: 七月，載洵等赴日、美二國考察。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Zaixun and others went on inspection tours to Japan and the United States.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Zaixun and his party toured Japan and the United States.

sentences.zh: 尋在英造應瑞、肇和，在德造建康、豫章、同安、江鯤、江犀，在日本造永翔、永豐，在江南船塢造永建、永績，在揚子江造船公司造建中、拱辰、永安，在膠州船塢造舞風各軍鑒。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the Yingrui and Zhaohe were built in Britain; the Jiankang, Yuzhang, Tong'an, Jiangkun, and Jiangxi in Germany; the Yongxiang and Yongfeng in Japan; the Yongjian and Yongji at the Jiangnan dry dock; the Jianzhong, Gongchen, and Yong'an at the Yangzi River Shipbuilding Company; and the Wufeng at the Jiaozhou dry dock—all warships.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter warships were built across several yards: the Yingrui and Zhaohe in Britain; the Jiankang, Yuzhang, Tong'an, Jiangkun, and Jiangxi in Germany; the Yongxiang and Yongfeng in Japan; the Yongjian and Yongji at Jiangnan; the Jianzhong, Gongchen, and Yong'an at the Yangzi River Shipbuilding Company; and the Wufeng at Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 冬，改海軍事務處為海軍部，以載洵、譚學衡為海軍部正副大臣，薩鎮冰為海軍統制，定九級官制。

translations.literal: In winter, the Naval Affairs Office was changed to the Navy Ministry; Zaixun and Tan Xueheng were made chief and vice chief ministers of the navy, Sa Zhenbing was made navy controller, and a nine-rank official system was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Naval Affairs Office became the Navy Ministry, with Zaixun and Tan Xueheng as chief and vice ministers, Sa Zhenbing as navy controller, and a nine-grade rank system established.

sentences.zh: 三年，令海琛軍艦赴南洋各埠，撫慰華僑。

translations.literal: In the third year, the warship Haichen was ordered to southern ports to comfort overseas Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year [Xuantong, 1911] the Haichen was sent to southern ports to reassure overseas Chinese communities.

sentences.zh: 六月，查察沿海砲臺。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, coastal batteries were inspected.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month coastal fortifications were inspected.

sentences.zh: 令海圻軍艦赴英賀加冕禮，旋赴美國。

translations.literal: The warship Haiqi was ordered to Britain for the coronation celebrations, and then to the United States.
translations.idiomatic: The Haiqi was dispatched to Britain for the coronation and then to the United States.

sentences.zh: 八月，江南船塢造澄海砲船成。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the Jiangnan dry dock completed the gunboat Chenghai.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Jiangnan dry dock launched the gunboat Chenghai.

sentences.zh: 是月，武昌變起，江海各兵艦悉附民軍。

translations.literal: That month the Wuchang uprising began, and all river and sea warships joined the revolutionary forces.
translations.idiomatic: That month, after the Wuchang uprising, every river and sea warship went over to the revolutionary army.

sentences.zh: 此建置海軍之概略也。

translations.literal: This is the general outline of naval establishment.
translations.idiomatic: Such is the broad outline of how the navy was established.

sentences.zh: 北洋海軍規制，北洋海軍，設於光緒中葉，直隸總督李鴻章實總之。

translations.literal: Beiyang Navy regulations. The Beiyang Navy was established in mid-Guangxu; Governor-General of Zhili Li Hongzhang actually directed it.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations of the Beiyang Navy. The Beiyang Navy was founded in mid-Guangxu under the effective direction of Zhili Governor-General Li Hongzhang.

sentences.zh: 其時有鎮遠、定遠鐵甲船二艘，濟遠、致遠、靖遠、經遠、來遠、超勇、揚威快船七艘，鎮中、鎮邊、鎮東、鎮西、鎮南、鎮北蚊砲船六艘，魚雷艇六艘，威遠、康濟、敏捷練船三艘，利運運船一艘。

translations.literal: At that time there were two ironclads, Zhenyuan and Dingyuan; seven fast ships, Jiyuan, Zhiyuan, Jingyuan, Jingyuan, Laiyuan, Chaoyong, and Yangwei; six mosquito gunboats, Zhenzhong, Zhenbian, Zhendong, Zhenxi, Zhennan, and Zhenbei; six torpedo boats; three drill ships, Weiyuan, Kangji, and Minjie; and one transport, Liyun.
translations.idiomatic: Its fleet then comprised the ironclads Zhenyuan and Dingyuan; the cruisers Jiyuan, Zhiyuan, Jingyuan, Jingyuan, Laiyuan, Chaoyong, and Yangwei; six mosquito gunboats; six torpedo boats; the drill ships Weiyuan, Kangji, and Minjie; and the transport Liyun.

sentences.zh: 鎮遠、定遠弁兵各三百二十九人。

translations.literal: The Zhenyuan and Dingyuan each had 329 officers and men.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhenyuan and Dingyuan each carried 329 officers and men.

sentences.zh: 致遠、濟遠、靖遠、來遠、經遠弁兵各二百二人。

translations.literal: The Zhiyuan, Jiyuan, Jingyuan, Laiyuan, and Jingyuan each had 202 officers and men.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhiyuan, Jiyuan, Jingyuan, Laiyuan, and Jingyuan each had 202 officers and men.

sentences.zh: 超勇、揚威弁兵各一百三十七人。

translations.literal: The Chaoyong and Yangwei each had 137 officers and men.
translations.idiomatic: The Chaoyong and Yangwei each had 137 officers and men.

sentences.zh: 左隊一號魚雷艇，弁兵二十九人。

translations.literal: The Left Squadron No. 1 torpedo boat had 29 officers and men.
translations.idiomatic: Left Squadron torpedo boat No. 1 had a complement of 29.

sentences.zh: 二號魚雷艇，三號魚雷艇，右隊一號魚雷艇，二號魚雷艇，三號魚雷艇，弁兵各二十八人。

translations.literal: Torpedo boats No. 2 and No. 3 of the left squadron and Nos. 1, 2, and 3 of the right squadron each had 28 officers and men.
translations.idiomatic: Left Squadron torpedo boats No. 2 and No. 3 and Right Squadron Nos. 1, 2, and 3 each had 28 officers and men.

sentences.zh: 鎮中、鎮東蚊砲船弁兵各五十五人。

translations.literal: The mosquito gunboats Zhenzhong and Zhendong each had 55 officers and men.
translations.idiomatic: The mosquito gunboats Zhenzhong and Zhendong each had 55 officers and men.

sentences.zh: 鎮邊、鎮西、鎮南、鎮北弁兵各五十五人。

translations.literal: The Zhenbian, Zhenxi, Zhennan, and Zhenbei each had 55 officers and men.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhenbian, Zhenxi, Zhennan, and Zhenbei each had 55 officers and men.

sentences.zh: 威遠、康濟練船弁兵各一百二十四人。

translations.literal: The drill ships Weiyuan and Kangji each had 124 officers and men.
translations.idiomatic: The drill ships Weiyuan and Kangji each had 124 officers and men.

sentences.zh: 敏捷夾板練船弁兵六十人。

translations.literal: The composite drill ship Minjie had 60 officers and men.
translations.idiomatic: The composite-hulled drill ship Minjie had 60 officers and men.

sentences.zh: 利運運船弁兵五十七人。

translations.literal: The transport Liyun had 57 officers and men.
translations.idiomatic: The transport Liyun had 57 officers and men.

sentences.zh: 練勇學堂弁兵十四人。

translations.literal: The drill cadet school had 14 officers and men.
translations.idiomatic: The drill cadet school had 14 officers and men.

sentences.zh: 砲目練勇二百七十人。

translations.literal: There were 270 gunnery cadets.
translations.idiomatic: Gun crews included 270 drill cadets.

sentences.zh: 凡弁兵四千餘人。

translations.literal: In all there were more than four thousand officers and men.
translations.idiomatic: The total complement exceeded four thousand officers and men.

sentences.zh: 其員弁之目：曰管帶，曰幫帶大副，曰魚雷大副，曰駕駛二副，曰槍砲二副，曰船械三副，曰舢板三副，曰正砲弁，曰水手總頭目，曰副砲弁，曰巡查，曰總管輪，曰二、三等管輪，曰水手正、副頭目，曰一、二、三等水手，曰一、二等管旗，曰魚雷頭目，曰一、二、三等升火，曰二等管艙，曰一、二等管油，曰一等管汽，曰油漆匠，曰木匠，曰電燈、鍋爐、洋槍、魚雷等匠，曰夫役，曰文案，曰支應官，曰醫官，曰一、二等舵工，曰一、二等雷兵，曰一、二、三等練勇，曰教習，曰學生。

translations.literal: The categories of personnel were: commanding officer; executive first lieutenant; torpedo first lieutenant; navigation second lieutenant; gunnery second lieutenant; ship's equipment third lieutenant; cutter third lieutenant; chief gunner; chief boatswain; assistant gunner; patrolman; chief engineer; second- and third-class engineers; chief and assistant boatswain's mates; first-, second-, and third-class seamen; first- and second-class signalmen; torpedo petty officers; first-, second-, and third-class stokers; second-class storekeeper; first- and second-class oilers; first-class steam engineer; painters; carpenters; electricians, boilermakers, rifle, and torpedo artificers; laborers; clerks; supply officers; medical officers; first- and second-class helmsmen; first- and second-class torpedo men; first-, second-, and third-class drill cadets; instructors; and cadets.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and ratings included commanding officers, executive and torpedo first lieutenants, navigation and gunnery second lieutenants, ship's equipment and cutter third lieutenants, chief and assistant gunners, boatswains and seamen of various grades, engineers and stokers, artificers, laborers, clerks, supply and medical officers, helmsmen, torpedo men, drill cadets, instructors, and students.

sentences.zh: 其官制，設海軍提督一員，統領全軍，駐威海衛。

translations.literal: Its official system established one naval commander-in-chief to command the whole force, stationed at Weihaiwei.
translations.idiomatic: The command structure placed one naval commander-in-chief at Weihaiwei over the entire fleet.

sentences.zh: 總兵二員，分左右翼，各統鐵艦，為領隊翼長。

translations.literal: Two major generals, dividing left and right wings, each commanded the ironclads as wing leaders.
translations.idiomatic: Two major generals led the left and right wings, each commanding the ironclad squadron as wing commander.

sentences.zh: 副將以下各官，以所帶船艦之大小，職事之輕重，別其品秩。

translations.literal: Officials from brigadier general downward were graded in rank according to the size of the ships they commanded and the weight of their duties.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks from brigadier general downward varied with the size of the ship commanded and the importance of the post.

sentences.zh: 總兵以下各官船居，不建衙署。

translations.literal: From major general downward, officials lived aboard ship and built no yamens.
translations.idiomatic: From major general down, officers lived aboard ship and maintained no shore headquarters.

sentences.zh: 副將五員，參將四員，游擊九員，都司二十七員，守備六十員，千總六十五員，把總九十九員，經制外委四十三員。

translations.literal: There were five brigadier generals, four colonels, nine lieutenant colonels, twenty-seven captains, sixty majors, sixty-five captains of companies, ninety-nine lieutenants, and forty-three extra-regiment deputies.
translations.idiomatic: The roster comprised five brigadier generals, four colonels, nine lieutenant colonels, twenty-seven captains, sixty majors, sixty-five company captains, ninety-nine lieutenants, and forty-three extra-regiment deputies.

sentences.zh: 其升擢之階，分為三途：曰戰官，由水師學堂出身，兼備天算、地輿、槍砲、魚雷、水雷、汽機諸學，及戰守機宜，充各船管帶，暨大、二、三副職事。

translations.literal: The path of promotion was divided into three tracks: combat officers, drawn from the naval academy, versed in astronomy, mathematics, geography, gunnery, torpedoes, mines, and steam machinery as well as battle and defense, serving as commanding officers and first, second, and third lieutenants;
translations.idiomatic: Promotion followed three tracks. Combat officers came from the naval academy, trained in astronomy, mathematics, geography, gunnery, torpedoes, mines, steam engineering, and tactics, and served as commanding officers and lieutenants;

sentences.zh: 曰藝官，由管輪學堂出身，充各船管輪，專司汽機者。

translations.literal: technical officers, drawn from the engineer academy, serving as chief engineers on each ship and specializing in steam machinery;
translations.idiomatic: technical officers came from the engineer academy and served as chief engineers in charge of machinery;

sentences.zh: 曰弁目，由練勇水手出身，充砲弁、水手等，專司槍砲、帆繩者。

translations.literal: and petty officers, drawn from drill cadets and seamen, serving as gunners, seamen, and the like and specializing in guns and rigging.
translations.idiomatic: petty officers came from drill cadets and seamen and handled guns, sails, and ropes.

sentences.zh: 各歸各途，論資升轉。

translations.literal: Each remained in his own track and was promoted by seniority.
translations.idiomatic: Each track promoted by seniority within its own line.

sentences.zh: 提鎮大員等，請旨簡放。

translations.literal: Commanders-in-chief, major generals, and other senior officers were appointed by imperial selection.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders-in-chief and major generals were appointed by imperial selection.

sentences.zh: 弁目等咨選海軍衙門送兵部帶領引見。

translations.literal: Petty officers and the like were nominated through the naval yamen and presented at the Board of War for audience.
translations.idiomatic: Petty officers were nominated through the naval yamen and presented to the Board of War for imperial audience.

sentences.zh: 統由北洋大臣節制調遣。

translations.literal: All were controlled and dispatched by the Beiyang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: The entire force remained under the Beiyang governor-general's command.

sentences.zh: 其考選海軍官學生也，一、英國語言文字，二、地輿圖說，三、算學至開平方諸方，四、幾何原本前六卷，五、代數至造對數表法，六、平弧三角法，七、駕駛諸法，八、測量天象推算經緯度諸法，九、重學，十、化學格致。

translations.literal: In selecting naval officer cadets, the subjects were: (1) English language and writing; (2) geography and cartography; (3) mathematics through square and cube roots; (4) the first six books of Euclid's Elements; (5) algebra through methods of constructing logarithm tables; (6) plane and spherical trigonometry; (7) navigation; (8) methods of observing celestial phenomena and calculating latitude and longitude; (9) mechanics; and (10) chemistry and natural philosophy.
translations.idiomatic: Naval cadets were examined in ten subjects: English; geography and maps; mathematics through roots; the first six books of Euclid; algebra through logarithm tables; plane and spherical trigonometry; navigation; celestial observation and latitude-longitude calculation; mechanics; and chemistry and natural philosophy.

sentences.zh: 肄業期四年，學成錄用。

translations.literal: The course of study lasted four years, after which graduates were employed.
translations.idiomatic: Training lasted four years, after which graduates entered service.

sentences.zh: 其考選練勇也，招沿海漁戶年壯者充之。

translations.literal: In selecting drill cadets, sturdy young men from coastal fishing households were recruited.
translations.idiomatic: Drill cadets were recruited from sturdy young men of coastal fishing families.

sentences.zh: 在練船練習帆繩盪槳泅水及輪砲之操法，洋槍刀劍之操法。

translations.literal: On drill ships they practiced rigging, rowing, swimming, and gun drill, as well as rifle, sword, and bayonet drill.
translations.idiomatic: They trained on drill ships in rigging, rowing, swimming, and gun drill, and in rifle, sword, and bayonet exercises.

sentences.zh: 由三等遞升至一等，以備充補水手。

translations.literal: They advanced from third class to first to fill vacancies among seamen.
translations.idiomatic: They rose from third to first class to fill seaman vacancies.

sentences.zh: 水手以上各級，核其才藝勞績，以次遞擢。

translations.literal: Above the rank of seaman, each grade was promoted in turn according to skill and merit.
translations.idiomatic: Above seaman rank, promotion followed skill and service record.

sentences.zh: 其俸餉規制，曰官弁俸銀，兵匠錢糧，船上差缺薪糧，各船俸餉，官弁傷廢俸，兵丁加賞，行船公費，醫藥費，酬應公費，歲需銀一百七十六萬八千一百餘兩。

translations.literal: The pay regulations covered officers' salaries, artisans' and soldiers' rations, shipboard allowances, each ship's pay, disabled officers' pensions, soldiers' bonuses, voyage expenses, medical costs, and entertainment expenses, requiring more than 1,768,100 taels of silver per year.
translations.idiomatic: Pay covered officers' salaries, artisans' and soldiers' rations, ship allowances, pensions, bonuses, voyage and medical expenses, and entertainment funds—more than 1,768,100 taels annually.

sentences.zh: 其定儀制也，曰冠服，曰相見禮節，曰國樂，曰軍樂，曰王命旗牌，曰印信。

translations.literal: In fixing ceremonial regulations, there were headgear and dress, meeting etiquette, national music, military music, imperial command flags and tablets, and seals.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremonial regulations covered dress, etiquette, national and military music, imperial command insignia, and seals.

sentences.zh: 其立軍規也，由提督秉公酌擬，呈報北洋大臣核辦，輕者記過，重者降級、革職、撤任。

translations.literal: In establishing military regulations, the commander-in-chief was to draft them fairly, report them to the Beiyang governor-general for approval, and apply lighter penalties of demerit and heavier ones of reduction in rank, dismissal, and removal from office.
translations.idiomatic: Discipline was set by the commander-in-chief, submitted to the Beiyang governor-general for approval: minor offenses earned demerits, serious ones reduction in rank, dismissal, or removal from office.

sentences.zh: 其餘不法等事，由提督援引會典雍正元年軍規四十條，參酌行之。

translations.literal: As for other unlawful matters and the like, the commander-in-chief was to cite the forty articles of military regulations from the first year of the Yongzheng reign in the Collected Statutes and apply them with appropriate adjustment.
translations.idiomatic: Other violations were handled by the commander-in-chief under the forty articles of Yongzheng-era military regulations in the Collected Statutes, applied as circumstances required.

sentences.zh: 其簡閱巡防也，逐日小操，按月大操。

translations.literal: In inspection and patrol defense, there were daily small drills and monthly grand drills.
translations.idiomatic: Inspection and patrol relied on daily small drills and monthly full exercises.

sentences.zh: 立冬以後，各艦赴南洋，與南瑞、南琛、開濟、鏡清、寰泰、保民等艦合操，巡閱江、浙、閩、廣沿海要隘，至新加坡以南各島，保護華商，兼資歷練。

translations.literal: After the Beginning of Winter, each ship proceeded to the South Seas and joined drills with the Nanrui, Nanchen, Kaiji, Jingqing, Huantai, Baomin, and other vessels, patrolling and inspecting coastal strongpoints of Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian, and Guangdong, as far as the islands south of Singapore, protecting Chinese merchants and gaining experience at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: After winter began, ships sailed south to drill with the Nanrui, Nanchen, Kaiji, Jingqing, Huantai, Baomin, and others, patrolling key coastal positions from Jiangsu to Guangdong and islands south of Singapore to protect Chinese merchants and train crews.

sentences.zh: 每逾三年，欽派王大臣與北洋大臣出海校閱，以定賞罰。

translations.literal: Every three years, an imperially appointed princely minister and the Beiyang governor-general went to sea for inspection to determine rewards and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Every three years an imperial commissioner and the Beiyang governor-general conducted sea inspections to assign rewards and penalties.

sentences.zh: 水師後路，儲備有資，應時取給。

translations.literal: The navy's rear supply line had adequate reserves, and supplies were drawn as needed.
translations.idiomatic: Rear logistics were adequately stocked and issued on demand.

sentences.zh: 船政由本境駐防提督主之。

translations.literal: The ship administration was directed by the garrison commander-in-chief of the local jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Local ship administration fell to the garrison commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 槍砲藥彈，收發考驗，則總管軍火專員主之。

translations.literal: Issue, receipt, and inspection of firearms, cannon, and ammunition were directed by a specialist in charge of ordnance.
translations.idiomatic: A dedicated ordnance officer handled firearms, guns, and ammunition—receipt, issue, and inspection.

sentences.zh: 兵弁衣糧，因公用費，總管糧餉專員主之。

translations.literal: Rations and clothing for soldiers and officers, and public expenses, were directed by a specialist in charge of provisions and pay.
translations.idiomatic: A pay and provisions officer managed rations, uniforms, and operational expenses.

sentences.zh: 他若學堂專員，測候譯書畫圖專員，醫藥專員，皆受命于海軍部，以專責任。

translations.literal: Other specialists—the academy officer, the specialists for observation, translation, drafting, and mapping, and the medical officer—all received orders from the Navy Ministry and bore sole responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: Academy staff, surveyors, translators, draftsmen, and medical officers all answered to the Navy Ministry, each with a defined charge.

sentences.zh: 旅順口大石船塢，及海口操防，特命文武大員董理。

translations.literal: The great stone dry dock at Lüshunkou and coastal defense drills were specially entrusted to civil and military senior officials for supervision.
translations.idiomatic: The Lüshunkou stone dry dock and harbor defenses were placed under senior civil and military officials.

sentences.zh: 其大沽木船塢，海防支應局，旅順、天津軍械局、製造局，旅順魚雷營，威海機器廠、養病院，由北洋大臣簡員董理，規模略備。

translations.literal: The Dagu wooden dry dock, the coastal defense support bureau, the Lüshun and Tianjin ordnance bureaus and manufacturing bureaus, the Lüshun torpedo camp, and the Weihai machine shop and convalescent hospital were supervised by officials selected by the Beiyang governor-general; the scale was largely complete.
translations.idiomatic: The Beiyang governor-general appointed supervisors for the Dagu wooden dock, coastal defense support office, Lüshun and Tianjin arsenals and factories, Lüshun torpedo station, and Weihai machine works and hospital—the facilities were largely in place.

sentences.zh: 自海軍挫敗，所餘南洋各兵艦，新舊大小不齊，僅備巡防之用。

translations.literal: Since the navy's defeat, the remaining warships of the South Seas varied in age and size and served only for patrol and defense.
translations.idiomatic: After the navy's defeat, surviving southern warships were a mismatched mix, fit only for patrol duty.

sentences.zh: 後雖復設北洋統領及幫統官，董理海軍事宜，名存而已。

translations.literal: Later, although the Beiyang commander and assistant commanders were reinstated to manage naval affairs, the posts existed in name only.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Beiyang commander and deputies were restored on paper, but effective control was gone.

sentences.zh: 福州船廠，，創於閩浙總督左宗棠、船政大臣沈葆楨。

translations.literal: The Fuzhou shipyard was founded in the fifth year of Tongzhi by Zuo Zongtang, governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang, and Shen Baozhen, Superintendent of Shipbuilding.
translations.idiomatic: The Fuzhou shipyard was established in Tongzhi 5 by Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general Zuo Zongtang and ship administration superintendent Shen Baozhen.

sentences.zh: 閩縣馬尾江，距省會四十里，海口六十里。

translations.literal: At Mawei River in Min County, it was forty li from the provincial capital and sixty li from the river mouth.
translations.idiomatic: It stood on the Mawei River in Min County, forty li from the provincial seat and sixty li from the estuary.

sentences.zh: 船塢，，創於船政大臣裴廕森，十九年告成。

translations.literal: The dry dock was founded in the thirteenth year of Guangxu by Pei Yinsen, Superintendent of Shipbuilding, and completed in the nineteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: The dry dock was begun in Guangxu 13 under superintendent Pei Yinsen and finished in Guangxu 19.

sentences.zh: 羅星塔距船廠三里，費二千餘萬，實為中國海軍之基。

translations.literal: Luoxing Pagoda stood three li from the shipyard; the cost exceeded twenty million taels, and it truly formed the foundation of China's navy.
translations.idiomatic: Three li from the yard stood Luoxing Pagoda. The project cost more than twenty million taels and became the foundation of the Chinese navy.

sentences.zh: 其船廠所分隸者：一曰工程處辦公所，以洋員領辦公所，華員入工程處。

translations.literal: The shipyard's subordinate divisions were: first, the engineering office, with a foreign officer heading the office and Chinese officers in the engineering department.
translations.idiomatic: The yard was divided into departments. First was the engineering office, headed by a foreign adviser with Chinese staff in the engineering section.

sentences.zh: 一曰繪事院，承繪船身、船機、鍋爐以及鑲配等總圖、分圖，圖成，乃按圖造船，兼精測算之學。

translations.literal: Second, the drafting office, which drew general and detail plans of hulls, engines, boilers, and fittings; when the plans were finished, ships were built according to them, and the office also mastered the science of calculation.
translations.idiomatic: Second was the drafting office, which produced master and detail plans of hulls, engines, boilers, and fittings; ships were built to these drawings, and the staff were trained in mathematics as well.

sentences.zh: 院廣六千八百方尺，繪生三十九人。

translations.literal: The office covered six thousand eight hundred square feet and employed thirty-nine draftsmen.
translations.idiomatic: The drafting hall covered 6,800 square feet and employed thirty-nine draftsmen.

sentences.zh: 一曰模廠，專任製造船模、汽鼓模各機件，以及細木雕刻各工。

translations.literal: Third, the pattern shop, specializing in making ship patterns, steam-drum patterns, and various machine parts, as well as fine wood carving.
translations.idiomatic: Third was the pattern shop, which made ship molds, boiler patterns, machine parts, and fine wood carving.

sentences.zh: 其能力須審圖理，諳折算，悉模型奧竅，辨五金冷熱漲縮之度。

translations.literal: Its workers had to understand drafting principles, be skilled in conversion calculations, know the secrets of modeling, and distinguish the degrees of expansion and contraction of metals under heat and cold.
translations.idiomatic: Workers had to read drawings, perform conversions, master modeling technique, and understand how metals expand and contract with temperature.

sentences.zh: 廠廣一萬五千一百二十方尺，設各種鋸機、刨機，各種旋機，凡二十具。

translations.literal: The shop covered fifteen thousand one hundred twenty square feet and was equipped with various saws, planers, and lathes, twenty machines in all.
translations.idiomatic: The shop covered 15,120 square feet and held twenty machines—saws, planers, and lathes of various kinds.

sentences.zh: 工程繁時，匠額一百六十人，恆時四十七人。

translations.literal: When work was heavy, the artisan quota was one hundred sixty; at ordinary times, forty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: At peak production it employed 160 artisans; the standing complement was 47.

sentences.zh: 一曰鑄鐵廠，專任船上所需之鑄銅鐵機件。

translations.literal: Fourth, the iron foundry, specializing in cast copper and iron parts required for ships.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth was the foundry, which cast the copper and iron parts ships required.

sentences.zh: 其能力須諳圖理，明算術，仿木模製土模，及鼓鑄之時，辨明火候，研考銅鐵原質。

translations.literal: Its workers had to know drafting principles and arithmetic, copy wooden patterns in clay molds, judge firing heat when casting, and study the nature of copper and iron.
translations.idiomatic: Foundrymen had to read drawings, calculate precisely, turn wooden patterns into sand molds, control furnace heat, and know the properties of copper and iron.

sentences.zh: 曾鑄成重大鐵件達三萬斤，銅件達一萬斤。

translations.literal: It had cast iron pieces weighing as much as thirty thousand jin and copper pieces as much as ten thousand jin.
translations.idiomatic: It had cast iron pieces up to 30,000 jin and copper pieces up to 10,000 jin.

sentences.zh: 廠廣二萬八千八百餘尺，設鑄銅鐵大小爐凡十一座，轉運重件之將軍柱、碾機、風箱、風櫃凡二十三具。

translations.literal: The foundry covered more than twenty-eight thousand eight hundred square feet, with eleven large and small copper and iron furnaces and twenty-three machines for moving heavy pieces—trip hammers, rolling mills, bellows, and blast chests.
translations.idiomatic: The foundry covered over 28,800 square feet, with eleven copper and iron furnaces and twenty-three heavy-lifting machines—trip hammers, rolling mills, bellows, and blast chests.

sentences.zh: 工程繁時，匠額一百六十餘人，恆時五十餘人。

translations.literal: When work was heavy, the artisan quota was more than one hundred sixty; at ordinary times, more than fifty.
translations.idiomatic: At peak production it employed over 160 artisans; the standing complement was over 50.

sentences.zh: 一曰船廠，凡舢板、皮廠、板築廠咸屬之，專任船身工程。

translations.literal: Fifth, the shipyard proper, to which the sampan shop, leather shop, and masonry shop all belonged, specializing in hull construction.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth was the main shipyard, including the sampan, leather, and masonry shops, devoted to hull construction.

sentences.zh: 設石製船臺一座，長二百九十七英尺，木製船臺一座，長二百七十六英尺。

translations.literal: It had one stone building slip two hundred ninety-seven feet long and one wooden building slip two hundred seventy-six feet long.
translations.idiomatic: It had a stone slip 297 feet long and a wooden slip 276 feet long.

sentences.zh: 凡船身長短廣狹，桅舵、艙位、頓載、速率、中心點度數，咸均算之。

translations.literal: All dimensions of the hull—length, breadth, masts, rudder, compartments, tonnage, speed, and center-point degrees—were calculated.
translations.idiomatic: Hull length, beam, masts, rudder, compartments, displacement, speed, and center of gravity were all calculated.

sentences.zh: 先繪經寸總圖，後繪全船，按圖造船。

translations.literal: First a master plan to scale was drawn, then the full ship, and construction followed the plans.
translations.idiomatic: Builders first drew a scaled master plan, then full-ship drawings, and built to those plans.

sentences.zh: 曾造木質、鐵質、鋼質、穹甲、鋼甲各式兵船四十餘艘。

translations.literal: It had built more than forty warships of wood, iron, steel, arched armor, and steel armor types.
translations.idiomatic: It had built more than forty warships in wood, iron, steel, arched-armor, and steel-armor designs.

sentences.zh: 其能力可製四、五千頓之船。

translations.literal: Its capacity could produce ships of four to five thousand tons.
translations.idiomatic: It was capable of building ships of four to five thousand tons.

sentences.zh: 所有起蓋鑲配，亦廠中經理。

translations.literal: All raising, covering, and fitting work was also managed within the yard.
translations.idiomatic: Raising, decking, and fitting were handled within the yard as well.

sentences.zh: 設有鋸木機八架。

translations.literal: It had eight sawing machines.
translations.idiomatic: It operated eight lumber saws.

sentences.zh: 所轄之皮廠，則製皮帶及各式皮件。

translations.literal: The leather shop under its jurisdiction made leather belts and various leather goods.
translations.idiomatic: Its leather shop made belts and assorted leather fittings.

sentences.zh: 舢板廠則製桅舵及大小舢板船。

translations.literal: The sampan shop made masts, rudders, and large and small sampan boats.
translations.idiomatic: The sampan shop built masts, rudders, and boats large and small.

sentences.zh: 板築所則造船上爐灶，及各煙筒爐灶一切泥水修築各工。

translations.literal: The masonry shop built shipboard stoves and all masonry work for chimneys, stoves, and related repairs.
translations.idiomatic: The masonry shop built galley stoves, funnels, and all related brick and plaster work.

sentences.zh: 廠廣十五萬六千四百餘尺。

translations.literal: The yard covered more than one hundred fifty-six thousand four hundred square feet.
translations.idiomatic: The yard covered over 156,400 square feet.

sentences.zh: 工程繁時，匠額一千三百餘人，恆時一百五十人。

translations.literal: When work was heavy, the artisan quota was more than one thousand three hundred; at ordinary times, one hundred fifty.
translations.idiomatic: At peak production it employed over 1,300 artisans; the standing complement was 150.

sentences.zh: 一曰鐵脅廠，專任製造鋼鐵船脅、船殼、龍骨橫梁、及船上鋼鐵件、拗彎鑲配各工廠。

translations.literal: Sixth, the iron-rib shop, specializing in making steel and iron ribs, hull plating, keels and beams, and all shipboard steel work, bending, and fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth was the iron-rib shop, which fabricated steel ribs, plating, keels, beams, and all bending and fitting of shipboard metal.

sentences.zh: 於光緒元年增設。

translations.literal: It was added in the first year of Guangxu.
translations.idiomatic: It was added in Guangxu 1.

sentences.zh: 其能力須審識船身圖理制度、鋼鐵原質各法。

translations.literal: Its workers had to understand hull drafting standards and the various properties of steel and iron.
translations.idiomatic: Workers had to master hull drawings and the properties of steel and iron.

sentences.zh: 曾製成鋼甲鋼鐵船身二十餘艘。

translations.literal: It had completed more than twenty armored steel hulls.
translations.idiomatic: It had built more than twenty armored steel hulls.

sentences.zh: 廠廣七萬九千八百餘尺，配設鋸機、翦機、鑽機、卷機、碾機、刨機三十五具。

translations.literal: The shop covered more than seventy-nine thousand eight hundred square feet and was equipped with thirty-five saws, shears, drills, rolling machines, grinding machines, and planers.
translations.idiomatic: The shop covered over 79,800 square feet and held thirty-five saws, shears, drills, rollers, grinders, and planers.

sentences.zh: 工程繁時，匠額七百人，恆時六十八人。

translations.literal: When work was heavy, the artisan quota was seven hundred; at ordinary times, sixty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: At peak production it employed 700 artisans; the standing complement was 68.

sentences.zh: 一曰拉鐵廠，專任拉製銅鐵，為製船所必需。

translations.literal: Seventh, the iron-rolling shop, specializing in rolling copper and iron, essential to shipbuilding.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh was the rolling mill, which rolled copper and iron essential to ship construction.

sentences.zh: 能拉製重大之銅鋼鐵板、銅鐵槽條，及重大之輪機、轉輪軸、車軸、轉輪臂、汽餅桿、活軌、鐵錨各件。

translations.literal: It could roll heavy copper, steel, and iron plates and bars, and heavy engine parts, wheel shafts, axles, crank arms, piston rods, slide rails, and anchors.
translations.idiomatic: It rolled heavy copper, steel, and iron plates and bars, plus large engine parts—wheel shafts, axles, crank arms, piston rods, slide rails, and anchors.

sentences.zh: 廠廣九萬四千四百餘尺，設汽鎚七架，汽鎚力大者至七頓。

translations.literal: The shop covered more than ninety-four thousand four hundred square feet and had seven steam hammers, the largest reaching seven tons.
translations.idiomatic: The shop covered over 94,400 square feet and operated seven steam hammers, the largest rated at seven tons.

sentences.zh: 此外拉機翦旋床、鑽機刨床、並轉運重機之將軍柱，凡大小五十一具。

translations.literal: Besides these, there were rolling machines, shearing lathes, drilling and planing machines, and trip hammers for moving heavy machinery—fifty-one large and small machines in all.
translations.idiomatic: It also held fifty-one machines in all—rolling and shearing lathes, drills, planers, and trip hammers for heavy lifting.

sentences.zh: 拉銅鐵打鐵各爐，凡大小五十七座。

translations.literal: There were fifty-seven large and small furnaces for rolling copper and iron and forging iron.
translations.idiomatic: It had fifty-seven furnaces for rolling and forging copper and iron.

sentences.zh: 工程繁時，匠額三百八十餘人，恆時八十七人。

translations.literal: When work was heavy, the artisan quota was more than three hundred eighty; at ordinary times, eighty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: At peak production it employed over 380 artisans; the standing complement was 87.

sentences.zh: 一曰輪機廠，附屬有合攏廠，專任全船大小機器，製成，先在廠試驗，故合攏廠屬之。

translations.literal: Eighth, the engine shop, with an attached assembly shop, specializing in all large and small ship machinery; once finished, machines were tested in the shop first, so the assembly shop belonged to it.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth was the engine shop with an attached assembly shop. It built all ship machinery, which was bench-tested before installation, so the assembly shop fell under it.

sentences.zh: 須較准中線，尤須審明圖理，通曉進脫冷暖壓助噓吃機關各竅汽力。

translations.literal: Workers had to align the center line precisely, understand drafting thoroughly, and master the secrets of steam power in admission, release, heating, cooling, pressure, assistance, exhaust, and intake.
translations.idiomatic: Engineers had to align center lines, read drawings precisely, and master steam mechanics—admission, release, heating, cooling, pressure, assist, exhaust, and intake.

sentences.zh: 廠廣三萬三千二百餘尺，設車光機、削機、刨機、礪石機、螺絲床、鉗床等，凡大小二百二十三具。

translations.literal: The shop covered more than thirty-three thousand two hundred square feet and was equipped with turning, cutting, planing, and grinding machines, screw lathes, vices, and the like—two hundred twenty-three large and small machines in all.
translations.idiomatic: The shop covered over 33,200 square feet and held 223 machines—turning, cutting, planing, and grinding tools, screw lathes, and vices.

sentences.zh: 工程繁時，匠額三百六十人，恆時一百二十人。

translations.literal: When work was heavy, the artisan quota was three hundred sixty; at ordinary times, one hundred twenty.
translations.idiomatic: At peak production it employed 360 artisans; the standing complement was 120.

sentences.zh: 一曰鍋爐廠，專任鍋爐、煙筒、煙艙、汽表、向盤各工。

translations.literal: Ninth, the boiler shop, specializing in boilers, smokestacks, smoke chambers, steam gauges, and steering wheels.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth was the boiler shop, which built boilers, funnels, smoke chambers, steam gauges, and steering wheels.

sentences.zh: 其能力須審辨鋼鐵原質，究汽機之理由，天氣之漲力，以及鑲配法度。

translations.literal: Its workers had to distinguish the nature of steel and iron, study the principles of steam engines, atmospheric pressure, and standards of fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Boilermakers had to know steel and iron properties, steam-engine theory, atmospheric pressure, and fitting standards.

sentences.zh: 廠廣二萬九千六百尺，配設卷鐵床、水力泡丁機翦床、鑽床、船床，凡四十一具。

translations.literal: The shop covered twenty-nine thousand six hundred square feet and was equipped with plate-rolling beds, hydraulic punching and shearing machines, drilling machines, and shaping machines—forty-one in all.
translations.idiomatic: The shop covered 29,600 square feet and held forty-one machines—plate rollers, hydraulic punch shears, drills, and shaping beds.

sentences.zh: 工程繁時，匠額三百五十人，恆時一百十七人。

translations.literal: When work was heavy, the artisan quota was three hundred fifty; at ordinary times, one hundred seventeen.
translations.idiomatic: At peak production it employed 350 artisans; the standing complement was 117.

sentences.zh: 一曰帆纜廠，專造船上之風帆、天遮、帆索、桅上鑲配繩索，及起重搭架各工。

translations.literal: Tenth, the sail and rigging shop, specializing in ship sails, awnings, halyards, mast fittings and ropes, and rigging for hoisting and scaffolding.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth was the sail and rigging shop, which made sails, awnings, halyards, mast ropes and fittings, and hoisting rigging.

sentences.zh: 其能力須審帆纜制度，登高工作，及風帆面積、繩索力度。

translations.literal: Its workers had to understand rigging standards, work at height, and calculate sail area and rope strength.
translations.idiomatic: Riggers had to know rigging standards, work aloft safely, and calculate sail area and rope strength.

sentences.zh: 廠廣一萬八千五百尺，不設機器，以手製為多。

translations.literal: The shop covered eighteen thousand five hundred square feet, used no machines, and relied mostly on hand work.
translations.idiomatic: The shop covered 18,500 square feet and relied mostly on hand work, with little machinery.

sentences.zh: 工程繁時，匠額七十人，恆時四十人。

translations.literal: When work was heavy, the artisan quota was seventy; at ordinary times, forty.
translations.idiomatic: At peak production it employed 70 artisans; the standing complement was 40.

sentences.zh: 一曰儲砲廠，專備收儲各船砲械、砲彈、魚雷各件。

translations.literal: Eleventh, the ordnance store, specializing in receiving and storing each ship's guns, shells, and torpedoes.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh was the ordnance depot, which stored guns, shells, and torpedoes for all ships.

sentences.zh: 廠廣二千六十尺，恆時守兵二人。

translations.literal: The depot covered two thousand sixty square feet and had two guards at ordinary times.
translations.idiomatic: The depot covered 2,060 square feet and was guarded by two sentries.

sentences.zh: 一曰廣儲所，附設儲材所，專任收發銅鐵煤炭機件油雜各料件，儲材之所，專任收發各種木料。

translations.literal: Twelfth, the general storehouse, with an attached timber store, specializing in receiving and issuing copper, iron, coal, machine parts, oil, and miscellaneous materials; the timber store specialized in receiving and issuing all kinds of lumber.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth was the general storehouse with an attached timber yard. The main store handled copper, iron, coal, machine parts, oil, and supplies; the timber yard handled all lumber.

sentences.zh: 凡船政料件到工，先由兩廠驗收。

translations.literal: Whenever ship administration materials arrived at the yard, both storehouses inspected them first.
translations.idiomatic: All materials arriving at the yard were inspected first by both storehouses.

sentences.zh: 其職任須審料質之良窳，慎重存儲。

translations.literal: Their duty was to judge the quality of materials and store them carefully.
translations.idiomatic: Storekeepers judged material quality and stored goods with care.

sentences.zh: 凡儲料棧房九座，廣四萬二千一百尺。

translations.literal: There were nine material warehouses covering forty-two thousand one hundred square feet in all.
translations.idiomatic: Nine material warehouses covered 42,100 square feet in all.

sentences.zh: 儲煤廠廣一萬五千一百尺。

translations.literal: The coal store covered fifteen thousand one hundred square feet.
translations.idiomatic: The coal yard covered 15,100 square feet.

sentences.zh: 廣儲所夫役，工程繁時六十人，恆時四十人。

translations.literal: Laborers at the general storehouse numbered sixty when work was heavy and forty at ordinary times.
translations.idiomatic: The general storehouse employed 60 laborers at peak and 40 normally.

sentences.zh: 儲材所簰夫，工程繁時三十六人，今存二人。

translations.literal: Raft hands at the timber store numbered thirty-six when work was heavy; only two remained now.
translations.idiomatic: The timber yard had 36 raft hands at peak production; only two remained.

sentences.zh: 一曰船槽，各國自建船塢後，多不設船槽，此槽乃初興船政時所設，可修一千頓以上之船。

translations.literal: Thirteenth, the ship slip: after nations built their own dry docks, most no longer kept slips; this slip was established when the ship administration was first founded and could repair ships of more than one thousand tons.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteenth was the ship slip. Most countries abandoned slips once they had dry docks; this one dated from the yard's founding and could service ships over 1,000 tons.

sentences.zh: 年久多損，僅能修整小船，較入塢為易。

translations.literal: After many years it was much damaged and could repair only small ships; entering the dry dock was easier by comparison.
translations.idiomatic: Age had worn it down; it could handle only small vessels, while the dry dock was easier to use.

sentences.zh: 槽長三百二十二尺，上設機房，凡廣一萬七千三百尺。

translations.literal: The slip was three hundred twenty-two feet long, with a machine house above; the total area was seventeen thousand three hundred square feet.
translations.idiomatic: The slip was 322 feet long with a machine house above, covering 17,300 square feet in all.

sentences.zh: 設拖船機四十架，大螺絲四十條，四十匹馬力一副。

translations.literal: It had forty hauling machines, forty large screws, and one set of forty-horsepower engines.
translations.idiomatic: It had forty hauling winches, forty large screws, and a 40-horsepower engine set.

sentences.zh: 工程繁時，匠額六十人，恆時三十七人。

translations.literal: When work was heavy, the artisan quota was sixty; at ordinary times, thirty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: At peak production it employed 60 artisans; the standing complement was 37.

sentences.zh: 一曰船塢，建築費五十萬，塢身純用石砌，長四百二十尺，廣一百十尺，足容定遠等鐵艦，閩、粵、江、浙各兵艦，及外國兵艦，咸得入塢修整。

translations.literal: Fourteenth, the dry dock: construction cost five hundred thousand taels; the dock body was built entirely of stone, four hundred twenty feet long and one hundred ten feet wide, large enough for ironclads such as the Dingyuan and warships of Fujian, Guangdong, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang, as well as foreign warships—all could enter for repairs.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth was the dry dock. It cost 500,000 taels to build, with a stone basin 420 by 110 feet—large enough for ironclads like the Dingyuan, provincial warships from Fujian, Guangdong, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang, and foreign vessels.

sentences.zh: 並建抽水機廠、機器廠、丁役水手房、木料棧房等。

translations.literal: Pumping-machine shops, machine shops, quarters for laborers and seamen, and timber warehouses were also built.
translations.idiomatic: It also included pumping stations, machine shops, crew quarters, and timber sheds.

sentences.zh: 面積凡二十九萬三千尺。

translations.literal: The total area was two hundred ninety-three thousand square feet.
translations.idiomatic: The whole facility covered 293,000 square feet.

sentences.zh: 有船入塢，由各廠飭匠修之。

translations.literal: When a ship entered the dock, artisans from the various shops were ordered to repair it.
translations.idiomatic: When a ship entered the dock, artisans from every shop were assigned to repair it.

sentences.zh: 恆時匠額二十七人。

translations.literal: The standing artisan quota was twenty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: The standing repair crew numbered 27.

sentences.zh: 船政經費，，首次報銷造船購費、蓋廠各費達五百十六萬兩，養船費十九萬兩。

translations.literal: Ship administration funds: in the thirteenth year of Tongzhi, the first reimbursement for shipbuilding purchases and yard construction reached five million one hundred sixty thousand taels, and ship maintenance cost one hundred ninety thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: Ship administration finances: the first Tongzhi 13 reimbursement for construction and purchases totaled 5.16 million taels, with 190,000 taels for maintenance.

sentences.zh: 後，船政常年費為六十萬兩。

translations.literal: Afterward, from the second year of Guangxu onward, the ship administration's annual budget was six hundred thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: After Guangxu 2 the yard's annual budget stood at 600,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 自至，造船四十艘，用銀八百五十二萬兩。

translations.literal: From the fifth year of Tongzhi to the thirty-third year of Guangxu, forty ships were built at a cost of eight million five hundred twenty thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: From Tongzhi 5 to Guangxu 33, forty ships were built at a cost of 8.52 million taels.

sentences.zh: 營造廠屋，用銀二百十一萬兩。

translations.literal: Building workshops cost two million one hundred ten thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Workshop construction cost 2.11 million taels.

sentences.zh: 裝造機器，用銀六十四萬兩。

translations.literal: Installing machinery cost six hundred forty thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Machinery installation cost 640,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 洋員歲俸，及修機器、置書籍，用銀五百五萬兩。

translations.literal: Foreign officers' annual salaries, machine repairs, and book purchases cost five million five hundred thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign advisers' salaries, machine repairs, and books cost 5.5 million taels.

sentences.zh: 學堂費六十七萬兩。

translations.literal: Academy expenses totaled six hundred seventy thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: The academy cost 670,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 養船費一百四十六萬兩。

translations.literal: Ship maintenance cost one million four hundred sixty thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: Ship upkeep cost 1.46 million taels.

sentences.zh: 經營船政四十餘年，凡用銀一千九百萬兩有奇。

translations.literal: Over more than forty years of operating the ship administration, the total expenditure exceeded nineteen million taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Over more than forty years of operation, total spending exceeded 19 million taels.

sentences.zh: 此福州船廠、船塢之概略也。

translations.literal: This is a general account of the Fuzhou shipyard and dry dock.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the Fuzhou shipyard and dry dock in outline.

sentences.zh: 又製火磚練鐵，亦具規模。

translations.literal: Firebrick and iron-smelting production were also established on a considerable scale.
translations.idiomatic: Firebrick and iron refining were also developed on a substantial scale.

sentences.zh: 至以後，洋監工全數遣散，遂無續製之船云。

translations.literal: After the thirty-third year of Guangxu, all foreign supervisors were dismissed, and no more ships were built thereafter.
translations.idiomatic: After Guangxu 33 all foreign supervisors were dismissed, and shipbuilding ceased.

sentences.zh: 旅順船塢，創議於直隸總督李鴻章。

translations.literal: The Lüshun dry dock was first proposed by Li Hongzhang, governor-general of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: The Lüshun dry dock was first proposed by Zhili governor-general Li Hongzhang.

sentences.zh: 時值外洋訂購兵艦到華，鴻章疏言，奉天金州旅順口形勢險要，局廠、船塢各工，當陸續籌興。

translations.literal: At the time foreign-ordered warships were arriving in China; Hongzhang submitted a memorial stating that Lüshunkou at Jinzhou in Fengtian was strategically vital and that bureau, yard, and dry-dock works should be planned and launched in succession.
translations.idiomatic: As foreign-built warships arrived in China, Li Hongzhang memorialized that Lüshunkou at Jinzhou, Fengtian, was strategically vital and that arsenals, yards, and dry docks should be built there in stages.

sentences.zh: 九年二月，續陳旅順工程，開山濬海，工大費鉅，實難預為估定。

translations.literal: In the second month of the ninth year, he further reported on the Lüshun project: cutting mountains and dredging the sea would be vast in scale and expense and truly difficult to estimate in advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Guangxu 9 he reported again on Lüshun: mountain cutting and dredging would be enormous in scope and cost, and hard to estimate in advance.

sentences.zh: 旋由法國人德威尼承攪，鴻章派員督同興辦，並增築攔潮石壩。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter the Frenchman Devigne undertook the contract; Hongzhang dispatched officials to supervise joint construction, and additionally built a tide-barrier stone dam.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the French contractor Devigne took over the work; Li Hongzhang sent officials to supervise construction jointly and added a stone tide barrier.

sentences.zh: 十六年秋，全工告成，派員赴旅順驗工。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the sixteenth year, the entire project was completed, and officials were dispatched to Lüshun to inspect the works.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Guangxu 16 the whole project was finished, and inspectors were sent to Lüshun to accept the works.

sentences.zh: 所築大石船塢，長四十一丈三尺，寬十二丈四尺，深三丈七尺，石階鐵梯滑道俱全。

translations.literal: The great stone dry dock built was forty-one zhang three chi long, twelve zhang four chi wide, and three zhang seven chi deep, with stone steps, iron ladders, and slipways all complete.
translations.idiomatic: The stone dry dock measured forty-one zhang three chi by twelve zhang four chi, with a depth of three zhang seven chi; stone steps, iron ladders, and slipways were all in place.

sentences.zh: 塢口以鐵船橫攔為門。

translations.literal: The dock mouth used an iron ship laid across as a gate.
translations.idiomatic: The entrance was closed by an iron caisson ship laid across the mouth like a gate.

sentences.zh: 全塢石工，俱用山東大方石，堊以西洋塞門德土，凝結堅實，堪為油修鐵甲戰艦之用。

translations.literal: All stone work of the dock used large square stones from Shandong, filled with Western cement; set hard and solid, suitable for caulking and repairing ironclad warships.
translations.idiomatic: The dock was built entirely of large Shandong ashlar, grouted with Western cement into a mass hard enough for docking ironclads for bottom work and repair.

sentences.zh: 其塢外停艦大石澳，東南北三面，共長四百十丈六尺，西面攔潮大石壩，長九十三丈四尺，形如方池。

translations.literal: Outside the dock was a great stone basin for mooring ships; on the east, south, and north together four hundred ten zhang six chi in length; on the west a great stone tide-barrier dam ninety-three zhang four chi long, shaped like a square pool.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the dock lay a stone anchorage basin: four hundred ten zhang six chi along the east, south, and north, closed on the west by a ninety-three zhang four chi tide dam—altogether like a square pool.

sentences.zh: 潮落時，尚深二丈四尺。

translations.literal: At low tide it was still two zhang four chi deep.
translations.idiomatic: Even at low tide the basin still held two zhang four chi of water.

sentences.zh: 西北留一口門，為兵船出入所由。

translations.literal: On the northwest one mouth was left as the passage for warships entering and leaving.
translations.idiomatic: A single opening was left on the northwest for warships to pass in and out.

sentences.zh: 四周悉砌石岸。

translations.literal: All around, stone banks were built.
translations.idiomatic: Stone quays were built all around.

sentences.zh: 由岸面量至澳底，深三丈八尺。

translations.literal: Measured from the bank surface to the basin bottom, the depth was three zhang eight chi.
translations.idiomatic: From the quay surface to the basin floor measured three zhang eight chi.

sentences.zh: 周岸泊船，不患風浪鼓盪。

translations.literal: Ships moored along the banks need not fear wind and waves tossing them.
translations.idiomatic: Vessels moored along the quays were sheltered from wind and swell.

sentences.zh: 凡兵艦入塢油底之後，即可出塢傍岸，鑲配修整，至為便利。

translations.literal: Whenever a warship entered the dock for bottom caulking, it could afterward leave the dock and lie alongside the bank for fitting and repair—extremely convenient.
translations.idiomatic: After a warship had been docked and her bottom caulked, she could leave the dock and lie alongside for fitting-out and repair with great convenience.

sentences.zh: 塢邊修船各廠九座，佔地四萬八千五百方尺，為鍋爐廠、機器廠、吸水鍋爐廠、吸水機器廠、木作廠、銅匠廠、鑄鐵廠、打鐵廠、電燈廠。

translations.literal: Nine repair shops were built beside the dock, occupying forty-eight thousand five hundred square chi: boiler shop, engine shop, boiler shop for pumps, engine shop for pumps, carpentry shop, coppersmith shop, iron-casting shop, forging shop, and electric-light shop.
translations.idiomatic: Nine workshops stood beside the dock on forty-eight thousand five hundred square chi: boiler, engine, pump-boiler, pump-engine, carpentry, coppersmith, foundry, forge, and electric-light shops.

sentences.zh: 又澳南岸建大庫四座，塢東建大庫一座。

translations.literal: Also four great storehouses were built on the south bank of the basin and one great storehouse east of the dock.
translations.idiomatic: Four large warehouses went up on the basin's south shore and one east of the dock.

sentences.zh: 每座佔地四千八百七十八方尺，備儲船械雜料。

translations.literal: Each occupied four thousand eight hundred seventy-eight square chi, for storing ship equipment and miscellaneous materials.
translations.idiomatic: Each covered four thousand eight hundred seventy-eight square chi and held stores, gear, and miscellaneous supplies.

sentences.zh: 以上廠庫，概用鐵梁鐵瓦，高寬堅固，足防風雪火患。

translations.literal: All the above shops and storehouses used iron beams and iron tiles throughout; high, wide, and solid, sufficient to guard against wind, snow, and fire.
translations.idiomatic: All these buildings were framed in iron and roofed with iron plate—high, broad, and stout enough to withstand wind, snow, and fire.

sentences.zh: 又於澳塢之四周，聯以鐵道九百七丈，間段設大小起重鐵架五座，專起重大之物，以濟人力之窮。

translations.literal: Also around the basin and dock nine hundred seven zhang of railway was linked, with five large and small iron lifting frames set at intervals, dedicated to hoisting heavy objects, to supplement where human strength fell short.
translations.idiomatic: Nine hundred seven zhang of railway encircled the basin and dock, with five large and small iron gantries at intervals to lift heavy loads where manpower alone would not suffice.

sentences.zh: 又於各廠庫馬頭等處，設大小電燈四十六座，為並作夜工之用。

translations.literal: Also at each shop, storehouse, wharf, and the like, forty-six large and small electric lights were installed for simultaneous night work.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-six electric lamps, large and small, were set up at the workshops, warehouses, and wharves so that night work could proceed in parallel.

sentences.zh: 慮近海鹹水之不宜食用也，遠引山泉，束以鐵管，由地中穿溪越隴，曲屈達於澳塢四旁，使水陸將士，機廠工匠，不致飲水生疾。

translations.literal: Fearing the unsuitability of nearby seawater for drinking, mountain spring water was brought from afar, channeled in iron pipes through the ground, crossing streams and ridges in winding course to reach the four sides of the basin and dock, so that land and naval officers and soldiers and factory artisans would not fall ill from drinking the water.
translations.idiomatic: Because nearby seawater was unfit to drink, spring water was piped in from the hills through iron conduits buried underground, winding across streams and ridges to the basin and dock on every side, so that soldiers, sailors, and yard hands would not sicken on brackish water.

sentences.zh: 又慮臨海遠灘之不便起卸也，建丁字式大鐵馬頭一座，使往來兵艦上煤運械，不致停滯。

translations.literal: Also fearing the inconvenience of loading and unloading on the distant tidal flat by the sea, one great T-shaped iron wharf was built so that incoming and outgoing warships coaling and transporting equipment would not be delayed.
translations.idiomatic: Because the open tidal flat made loading and unloading awkward, a large T-shaped iron pier was built so that coaling and cargo work for visiting warships would not stall.

sentences.zh: 其餘如修小輪船之小石塢，藏舢板之鐵棚，繫船浮標鐵臼，以及各廠內一應修船機器，設置完備。

translations.literal: The rest—such as a small stone dock for repairing small steam launches, an iron shed for storing sampans, iron mooring buoys and iron bollards, and all requisite ship-repair machinery within each shop—were completely installed.
translations.idiomatic: There were also a small stone dock for steam launches, an iron shed for sampans, mooring buoys and iron bollards, and every sort of repair machinery in the shops—all fully provided.

sentences.zh: 於是年九月二十七日工竣。

translations.literal: The works were completed on the twenty-seventh day of the ninth month of that year.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-seventh day of the ninth month of that year the works were declared complete.

sentences.zh: 由是日起，限一年，系代德威尼擔保之銀行照料。

translations.literal: From that day a limit of one year was set, during which a bank standing surety for Devigne would oversee maintenance.
translations.idiomatic: From that date a one-year term was fixed during which upkeep would be handled by the bank that had guaranteed Devigne.

sentences.zh: 限滿，再保固十年，均與包工監工洋人訂明。

translations.literal: When the limit expired, a further ten-year warranty was guaranteed; all was stipulated with the foreign contractor and supervising engineer.
translations.idiomatic: When that year ended, a further ten-year warranty was agreed—all spelled out with the foreign contractor and supervising engineer.

sentences.zh: 此項工程，共用銀二百餘萬兩。

translations.literal: This project in total used over two million taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: The whole undertaking cost more than two million taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 甲午後，遂迭為日、俄所踞云。

translations.literal: After jiawu (1894), it was successively occupied by Japan and Russia, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jiawu War it passed in turn to Japanese and then Russian control, it is said.

sentences.zh: 沿海軍港，旅順、威海既失，海軍無駐泊之所，於是籌邊者起議築港。

translations.literal: Of coastal naval ports, once Lüshun and Weihai were lost, the navy had no place to anchor; so border planners raised discussion of building ports.
translations.idiomatic: With Lüshun and Weihai gone, the fleet had nowhere to anchor along the coast, and frontier planners began debating new naval bases.

sentences.zh: 宣統初，命親籓南下，建築未遑。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xuantong, an order was issued for a member of the imperial clan to go south, but construction had not yet begun.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xuantong reign a prince of the blood was ordered south to oversee the work, but building had not yet started.

sentences.zh: 而沿海七千里，港灣鱗次，就海軍部所預籌，分為四區。

translations.literal: Yet along seven thousand li of coast, harbors and bays lay in close succession; according to the Navy Ministry's preliminary planning, they were divided into four districts.
translations.idiomatic: Yet along seven thousand li of coastline harbors and bays lay one after another; the Navy Ministry's preliminary plan divided them into four zones.

sentences.zh: 第一區，營口在奉天遼河左岸錦州灣，為渤海兩岸之良港。

translations.literal: First district: Yingkou at Jinzhou Bay on the left bank of the Liao River in Fengtian—a fine port on both shores of the Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: Zone one: Yingkou at Jinzhou Bay on the Liao River's left bank in Fengtian—a sound harbor on both sides of the Bohai.

sentences.zh: 大沽口為直隸諸水入海所匯。

translations.literal: Dagu mouth is where the waters of Zhili converge and enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Dagu estuary is where Zhili's rivers gather and reach the sea.

sentences.zh: 秦皇島東控山海關，為不凍之港。

translations.literal: Qinhuangdao controls Shanhaiguan to the east—a port that does not freeze.
translations.idiomatic: Qinhuangdao commands Shanhaiguan to the east and offers an ice-free harbor.

sentences.zh: 長山列島分內外三層，為旅順外援。

translations.literal: The Changshan archipelago forms inner, middle, and outer layers—outer support for Lüshun.
translations.idiomatic: The Changshan islands form three concentric tiers and serve as an outer screen for Lüshun.

sentences.zh: 大連灣在遼東半島南。

translations.literal: Dalian Bay lies on the south of the Liaodong Peninsula.
translations.idiomatic: Dalian Bay sits on the southern side of the Liaodong Peninsula.

sentences.zh: 芝罘港在山東福山縣，三面負山，北臨渤海。

translations.literal: Zhifu port is in Fushan County, Shandong; on three sides backed by mountains, on the north facing the Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: Zhifu Harbor lies in Fushan County, Shandong, mountains on three sides and the Bohai to the north.

sentences.zh: 第二區，揚子江口為沿江七省之門戶，沙灘連亙，多喑礁。

translations.literal: Second district: the Yangzi mouth is the gateway of the seven provinces along the river; sand beaches stretch unbroken, with many submerged reefs.
translations.idiomatic: Zone two: the Yangzi estuary is the gateway to seven river provinces; sandbars run on and on, and hidden reefs are many.

sentences.zh: 舟山在定海縣，諸山環列，為杭州海灣之屏蔽。

translations.literal: Zhoushan is in Dinghai County; mountains ring it on all sides—the screen of Hangzhou Bay.
translations.idiomatic: Zhoushan, in Dinghai County, is ringed by peaks and shields Hangzhou Bay.

sentences.zh: 象山港海深可泊巨艦，為寧波後路。

translations.literal: Xiangshan Bay is deep enough to moor great ships—the rear route of Ningbo.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangshan Bay is deep enough for capital ships and secures Ningbo's rear.

sentences.zh: 三門灣在臨海縣，有三門列島，海水甚深。

translations.literal: Sanmen Bay is in Linhai County; the Sanmen island group there—the seawater is very deep.
translations.idiomatic: Sanmen Bay in Linhai County, with the Sanmen islands offshore, holds very deep water.

sentences.zh: 第三區，永嘉灣即甌江口，三都澳即三沙灣，在福建霞浦縣，港口水淺，港內水深，容大軍艦。

translations.literal: Third district: Yongjia Bay is the Ou River mouth; Sandu Ao is Sansha Bay, in Xiapu County, Fujian—the port mouth is shallow but within the harbor deep, accommodating large warships.
translations.idiomatic: Zone three: Yongjia Bay is the Ou River estuary; Sandu Ao, or Sansha Bay, in Xiapu County, Fujian, has a shallow entrance but deep inner waters fit for large warships.

sentences.zh: 福州灣即閩江口，群島林立，淺岸交錯，為完固之港。

translations.literal: Fuzhou Bay is the Min River mouth; islands stand in clusters, shallow shores interwoven—a secure port.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhou Bay at the Min River mouth is studded with islands and shoals—a naturally defensible harbor.

sentences.zh: 海檀島為閩省海岸中樞。

translations.literal: Haitan Island is the central pivot of Fujian's coast.
translations.idiomatic: Haitan Island sits at the center of Fujian's coast.

sentences.zh: 廈門港有廈門、金門二島，近接臺灣。

translations.literal: Xiamen port has the two islands of Xiamen and Kinmen, close to Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiamen Harbor comprises Xiamen and Kinmen islands, close to Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 汕頭港在廣東澄海縣，崖岸峻險。

translations.literal: Shantou port is in Chenghai County, Guangdong; cliffs and shores steep and perilous.
translations.idiomatic: Shantou Harbor in Chenghai County, Guangdong, has steep cliffs and rugged shores.

sentences.zh: 番禺灣即廣州灣，巨石環列，擅天然形勢。

translations.literal: Panyu Bay is Guangzhou Bay; great rocks ring it, possessing natural advantages of terrain.
translations.idiomatic: Panyu Bay—Guangzhou Bay—is encircled by great rocks and enjoys a commanding natural position.

sentences.zh: 第四區，海口島在廣東瓊山縣北，與雷州島對峙，為扼隘之所。

translations.literal: Fourth district: Haikou Island is north of Qiongshan County, Guangdong, facing Leizhou Island across the way—a place of strategic chokepoint.
translations.idiomatic: Zone four: Haikou Island north of Qiongshan County, Guangdong, faces Leizhou Peninsula across the strait—a natural choke point.

sentences.zh: 榆林港在瓊州島南，背負崖壁，前臨東京灣。

translations.literal: Yulin port is on the south of Qiongzhou Island, backed by cliff walls, fronting the Gulf of Tonkin.
translations.idiomatic: Yulin Harbor on southern Hainan lies against cliff walls and looks out on the Gulf of Tonkin.

sentences.zh: 以上各港，惟象山港、三都澳確定為修築軍港之地。

translations.literal: Of the above ports, only Xiangshan Bay and Sandu Ao were confirmed as sites for building naval ports.
translations.idiomatic: Of these harbors, only Xiangshan Bay and Sandu Ao were chosen as definite sites for naval bases.

sentences.zh: 他如北塘口、榮成灣、靖海灣、葫蘆島、大鵬灣、廟島等處，亦由漸擴充云。

translations.literal: Others such as Beitang mouth, Rongcheng Bay, Jinghai Bay, Huludao, Dapeng Bay, Miaodao, and the like would also be gradually expanded, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: Others—Beitang, Rongcheng Bay, Jinghai Bay, Huludao, Dapeng Bay, Miaodao, and the like—were also to be developed step by step, it is said.

sentences.zh: 外國訂購各兵艦，始於咸豐十年，廷議購船艦砲位助剿粵寇。

translations.literal: Foreign purchase of warships began in the tenth year of Xianfeng, when the court debated buying ships and cannon to assist in suppressing the rebels in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: China's foreign warship purchases began in Xianfeng 10, when the court debated buying ships and guns to help suppress the Guangdong rebels.

sentences.zh: 十一年，總理各國事務衙門與總稅務司會商購買。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the Zongli Yamen consulted with the Inspector General of Customs on purchase.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the Zongli Yamen and the Inspector General of Customs jointly planned the purchases.

sentences.zh: 自同治、光緒朝迄宣統初年，歷五十年，得船不及百艘，爰依次歲月列其船名。

translations.literal: From the Tongzhi and Guangxu reigns through the early Xuantong era, over fifty years, fewer than a hundred ships were obtained; here their names are listed in chronological order.
translations.idiomatic: From Tongzhi and Guangxu through early Xuantong—fifty years in all—China acquired fewer than a hundred vessels; their names are listed below in order.

sentences.zh: 凡所購之國，所造之廠，及丈尺、馬力、頓數、砲位、兵弁咸詳之。

translations.literal: In every case the country of purchase, factory of construction, dimensions, horsepower, tonnage, gun mounts, and officers and men are given in detail.
translations.idiomatic: For each, country of purchase, builder, dimensions, horsepower, tonnage, armament, and complement are recorded in full.

sentences.zh: 其應瑞巡洋艦一艘，永豐、永翔砲艦二艘，建康、豫章、同安驅逐艦三艘，建中、永安、拱辰淺水快船二艘，告成於宣統三年後者不與焉。

translations.literal: The cruiser Yingrui, the two gunboats Yongfeng and Yongxiang, the three destroyers Jiankang, Yuzhang, and Tong'an, and the two shallow-draft fast boats Jianzhong, Yong'an, and Gongchen—those completed after Xuantong 3 are not included.
translations.idiomatic: The cruiser Yingrui, gunboats Yongfeng and Yongxiang, destroyers Jiankang, Yuzhang, and Tong'an, and shallow-draft fast boats Jianzhong, Yong'an, and Gongchen—vessels finished after Xuantong 3—are omitted here.

sentences.zh: 金臺船、原名北京。

translations.literal: Jintai ship, originally named Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: The Jintai, originally named the Beijing.

sentences.zh: 一統船、原名中國。

translations.literal: Yitong ship, originally named China.
translations.idiomatic: The Yitong, originally named the China.

sentences.zh: 廣萬船、原名廈門。

translations.literal: Guangwan ship, originally named Xiamen.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangwan, originally named the Xiamen.

sentences.zh: 得勝船、原名穆克德恩。

translations.literal: Desheng ship, originally named Mukd'en.
translations.idiomatic: The Desheng, originally named the Mukd'en.

sentences.zh: 百粵船、原名廣東。

translations.literal: Baiyue ship, originally named Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: The Baiyue, originally named the Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 三衛船、原名天津。

translations.literal: Sanwei ship, originally named Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: The Sanwei, originally named the Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 鎮吳船，原名江蘇。

translations.literal: Zhenwu ship, originally named Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhenwu, originally named the Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，在英國訂購。

translations.literal: Tongzhi year 1, ordered from Britain.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered from Britain in Tongzhi 1.

sentences.zh: 二年到華，價銀八十萬兩。

translations.literal: Year 2 arrived in China, price eight hundred thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: They reached China in the second year at a cost of eight hundred thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 以英國總兵阿思本為總統，以長江水師武員分統各船。

translations.literal: The British commander Osborn was made overall commander; Yangtze naval military officers each commanded ships.
translations.idiomatic: Britain's Commander Osborn was appointed fleet commander; Yangtze naval officers took charge of individual ships.

sentences.zh: 旋議以武職大員為漢總統，阿思本副之。

translations.literal: Soon it was proposed that a high Chinese military officer serve as Chinese commander with Osborn as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Soon it was proposed that a senior Chinese officer command the fleet with Osborn as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 是年六月，李鴻章以金陵垂克，勿庸外國兵船助剿，疏請所購七船，令阿思本駕駛回英，變價售賣，款歸中國。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of that year, Li Hongzhang, as Jinling was about to fall, that foreign warships were no longer needed to assist suppression, memorialized requesting the seven purchased ships be sent back to Britain under Osborn's command, sold for cash, proceeds to China.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of that year Li Hongzhang, with Jinling nearly taken and foreign gunboats no longer needed, asked that Osborn sail the seven purchased ships back to Britain, sell them, and remit the proceeds to China.

sentences.zh: 所募水兵，一律遣散。

translations.literal: All recruited sailors were dismissed uniformly.
translations.idiomatic: All enlisted sailors were discharged.

sentences.zh: 天平船，同治二年，由總稅務司購買。

translations.literal: Tianping ship—in Tongzhi year 2, purchased by the Inspector General of Customs.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianping: purchased by the Inspector General of Customs in Tongzhi 2.

sentences.zh: 安瀾船、定濤船、澄清船、綏靖船、飛龍船、鎮海船，同治五、六年間，兩廣總督瑞麟自英國購置，價銀二十四萬兩。

translations.literal: Anlan, Dingtao, Chengqing, Suijing, Feilong, and Zhenhai ships—in Tongzhi years 5–6, purchased from Britain by Liangguang governor-general Ruilin, price two hundred forty thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: The Anlan, Dingtao, Chengqing, Suijing, Feilong, and Zhenhai: bought from Britain by Liangguang governor-general Ruilin in Tongzhi 5–6 for two hundred forty thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 恬波船，同治七年，兩廣總督瑞麟自法國購置，價銀四萬兩。

translations.literal: Tianbo ship—Tongzhi year 7, purchased from France by Ruilin, price forty thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianbo: purchased from France by Ruilin in Tongzhi 7 for forty thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 海東雲船，原名五雲車。

translations.literal: Haidongyun ship, originally named Wuyunche.
translations.idiomatic: The Haidongyun, originally named the Wuyunche.

sentences.zh: 同治九年，閩浙總督英桂自洋商購置，以武員管駕，巡緝臺灣洋面。

translations.literal: Tongzhi year 9, purchased from foreign merchants by Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general Yinggui; military officers commanded patrol of Taiwan waters.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 9 Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general Yinggui bought her from foreign merchants; naval officers patrolled the seas off Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 主建威練船，同治九年，閩浙總督英桂購自德國，為駐練學生之用。

translations.literal: Jianwei training ship—Tongzhi year 9, purchased from Germany by Yinggui, for use by students in residence training.
translations.idiomatic: The Jianwei training ship: bought from Germany by Yinggui in Tongzhi 9 for cadets in residence.

sentences.zh: 福勝砲艦、建勝砲艦，同治十三年，福建善後局購自美國，光緒二年到華，價銀二十四萬兩。

translations.literal: Fusheng and Jiansheng gunboats—Tongzhi year 13, purchased from America by the Fujian Pacification Bureau, arrived in Guangxu year 2, price two hundred forty thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: The gunboats Fusheng and Jiansheng: ordered from the United States by the Fujian Pacification Bureau in Tongzhi 13, arrived in Guangxu 2 at a cost of two hundred forty thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 龍驤砲艦、虎威砲艦、飛艇砲艦、策電砲艦，光緒元年，直隸總督李鴻章自英國阿摩士庄廠訂購，每艘價銀十五萬兩，撥歸南洋調遣。

translations.literal: Longxiang, Huwei, Feiting, and Cedain gunboats—Guangxu year 1, ordered from the British Armstrong works by Zhili governor-general Li Hongzhang, each ship price one hundred fifty thousand taels of silver, assigned to the Nanyang fleet.
translations.idiomatic: The gunboats Longxiang, Huwei, Feiting, and Cedain: ordered from Britain's Armstrong works by Li Hongzhang in Guangxu 1 at one hundred fifty thousand taels each and assigned to the Nanyang fleet.

sentences.zh: 鎮東砲艦、鎮西砲艦、鎮南砲艦、鎮北砲艦，光緒元年，兩江總督李宗羲自英國阿摩士庄廠訂購，每艘價銀十五萬兩，撥歸北洋調遣。

translations.literal: Zhendong, Zhenxi, Zhennan, and Zhenbei gunboats—Guangxu year 1, ordered from the British Armstrong works by Liangjiang governor-general Li Zongyi, each ship price one hundred fifty thousand taels of silver, assigned to the Beiyang fleet.
translations.idiomatic: The gunboats Zhendong, Zhenxi, Zhennan, and Zhenbei: ordered from Armstrong by Li Zongyi in Guangxu 1 at one hundred fifty thousand taels each and assigned to the Beiyang fleet.

sentences.zh: 鎮中砲艦、鎮邊砲艦，光緒七年，李鴻章代山東省自英國船廠訂購，每艘價銀十五萬兩。

translations.literal: Zhenzhong and Zhenbian gunboats—Guangxu year 7, ordered from a British shipyard by Li Hongzhang on Shandong Province's behalf, each ship price one hundred fifty thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: The gunboats Zhenzhong and Zhenbian: ordered from a British yard by Li Hongzhang for Shandong in Guangxu 7 at one hundred fifty thousand taels each.

sentences.zh: 超勇巡洋艦、揚威巡洋艦，光緒五年，李鴻章自英國阿摩士庄廠訂購。

translations.literal: Chaoyong and Yangwei cruisers—Guangxu year 5, ordered from the British Armstrong works by Li Hongzhang.
translations.idiomatic: The cruisers Chaoyong and Yangwei: ordered from Armstrong by Li Hongzhang in Guangxu 5.

sentences.zh: 六年，令提督丁汝昌率員弁二百餘人，赴英國駕駛回華。

translations.literal: Year 6, Rear Admiral Ding Ruchang led over two hundred officers and men to Britain to sail them back to China.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Rear Admiral Ding Ruchang took more than two hundred officers and men to Britain and brought the ships home.

sentences.zh: 二艦均木身鋼板。

translations.literal: Both ships had wooden hulls with steel plating.
translations.idiomatic: Both were wooden ships sheathed in steel plate.

sentences.zh: 定遠鐵甲艦、鎮遠鐵甲艦，光緒六年，李鴻章自德國伏爾鏗廠訂購，價銀六百二十萬馬克。

translations.literal: Dingyuan and Zhenyuan ironclads—Guangxu year 6, ordered from the German Vulcan works by Li Hongzhang, price six million two hundred thousand marks.
translations.idiomatic: The ironclads Dingyuan and Zhenyuan: ordered from Germany's Vulcan works by Li Hongzhang in Guangxu 6 for six million two hundred thousand marks.

sentences.zh: 十一年來華，附小魚雷艇三艘，魚雷筒三具，小輪船一艘。

translations.literal: Year 11 arrived in China, with three small torpedo boats, three torpedo tubes, and one small steam launch attached.
translations.idiomatic: They reached China in the eleventh year, accompanied by three small torpedo boats, three torpedo tubes, and one steam launch.

sentences.zh: 濟遠鋼甲艦，光緒六年，與定遠船同廠訂購。

translations.literal: Jiyuan armored cruiser—Guangxu year 6, ordered from the same factory as the Dingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The armored cruiser Jiyuan: ordered from the same yard as the Dingyuan in Guangxu 6.

sentences.zh: 單雷艇二艘，光緒八年，由德國訂購，歸北洋調遣。

translations.literal: Two single torpedo boats—Guangxu year 8, ordered from Germany, assigned to the Beiyang fleet.
translations.idiomatic: Two single-hulled torpedo boats: ordered from Germany in Guangxu 8 and assigned to the Beiyang fleet.

sentences.zh: 雷龍魚雷艇、雷虎魚雷艇、雷中魚雷艇，光緒八年，兩廣總督張之洞由德國訂購。

translations.literal: Leilong, Leihu, and Leizhong torpedo boats—Guangxu year 8, ordered from Germany by Liangguang governor-general Zhang Zhidong.
translations.idiomatic: The torpedo boats Leilong, Leihu, and Leizhong: ordered from Germany by Zhang Zhidong in Guangxu 8.

sentences.zh: 雷乾魚雷艇、雷坤魚雷艇、雷離魚雷艇、雷坎魚雷艇、雷震魚雷艇、雷艮魚雷艇、雷巽魚雷艇、雷兌魚雷艇，光緒十年，兩廣總督張之洞由德國訂購。

translations.literal: Leiqian, Leikun, Leili, Leikan, Leizhen, Leigen, Leixun, and Leidui torpedo boats—Guangxu year 10, ordered from Germany by Zhang Zhidong.
translations.idiomatic: The torpedo boats Leiqian, Leikun, Leili, Leikan, Leizhen, Leigen, Leixun, and Leidui: ordered from Germany by Zhang Zhidong in Guangxu 10.
